The implementation is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: TileMix提出了一种以score-tile为中心的混合精度注意力内核，将注意力矩阵划分为硬件对齐的分数tile组，通过压缩的位掩码路由决策将每个tile组分配到FP16或INT8计算路径，两者在融合的在线softmax流式执行中更新同一共享状态。该方法无需训练，保留密集token连接性，支持GQA、可变长度批处理和INT8 KV缓存，在LLaMA、Qwen、Vicuna模型上恢复了均匀INT8损失的长上下文质量并提升了预填充吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM预填充阶段中，密集自注意力需要O(L²)的query-key分数计算与内存流量，现有方法要么采用统一的低精度路径，要么选择token交互，但都未在融合密集注意力内对硬件对齐的score tile进行空间精度路由，限制了精度-效率权衡的灵活性。
AI.method: TileMix将注意力矩阵划分为BLOCK_M×BLOCK_N的硬件对齐计算tile，将相邻key tile组合为路由组（通过分组因子g），将路由决策打包为每(h_k, m)一个64位位掩码。在FlashAttention风格的内核中，每个query tile row读入一个打包路由字，通过移位-掩码操作以常数时间查表，将对应key tile组分派到FP16 matmul或INT8 Tensor Core MMA（INT32累加+rescale）路径，两条路径在rescale后进入同一FP16 score域并更新共享的在线softmax状态（行最大值、归一化器、输出累加器）。系统支持quantize-once和fused on-the-fly两种操作数准备模式，INT8 KV缓存接口，以及GQA和变长批处理。
AI.result: 在LongEval（行级检索）、LV-Eval（11个中英长上下文QA数据集，16k-64k）和A100预填充基准测试上，使用LLaMA 3.2 3B、Qwen 2/2.5 7B、Vicuna 7B进行评估。TileMix恢复了均匀INT8（One）损失的大部分长上下文质量，SpTrans布局在多个任务上一致优于MInference和FlexPrefill等稀疏基线及SageAttention；吞吐量方面，在4k tokens时SpTrans75达到31.80 K tokens/s，超过FlashAttention（14.33）和One（29.80）。数值偏差随INT8覆盖率增加而增长，FP16与FP32累加的差异小于路由精度的影响，且结构化路由（如SpTrans25）仅将约8.5%的高重要性注意力质量路由到INT8，远低于25%的tile组覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: TileMix将score-tile组精度路由确立为长上下文注意力的内核原生抽象，在保留完整token连接性的同时，通过单个融合计算内的FP16/INT8路径分配实现可控的精度-效率前沿。该方法无需训练，支持GQA、变长批处理和INT8 KV缓存，跨模型族恢复了均匀INT8损失的质量并提升了FP16的吞吐量，为密集注意力内核提供了空间精度控制这一实用维度。

title: LLM-Only PDDL Domain Repair with Open-Weight Models
summary: AI planning is concerned with finding a sequence of actions that achieves a specified goal. It relies on explicit models of the world, commonly represented in the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL). An active line of research investigates how errors in such models can be detected and repaired. For example, users may provide positive test plans that are solutions, and negative test plans that fail during execution. Automated repair methods then modify the PDDL model to satisfy these constraints. In this paper, we evaluate the ability of recent open-weight large language models to perform this repair task using an LLM-only approach. Our experiments show that the symbolic baseline achieves an $F_1$ score of $.49$, while the best-performing LLM reaches $.87$ with high reasoning effort, an absolute improvement of $.38$. However, that setting has a mean test pass rate of only $.82$, falling to $.06$ on the Thoughtful domain; even the best setting that includes the test traces reaches only $.92$. Thus, current open-weight models cannot guarantee satisfaction of the test constraints required for reliable automated model repair.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了近期开源大语言模型(LLM)单独执行PDDL规划域修复任务的能力。研究发现，表现最佳的LLM在F₁分数上(.87)显著优于符号基线(.49)，但其测试通过率(TR)仅为0.82，在Thoughtful域上更降至0.06，表明当前开源LLM虽能提升语义修复质量，却无法保证满足所有测试约束所需的严格正确性。
AI.motivation: AI规划依赖显式的PDDL世界模型，但构建这些模型是实际部署的主要瓶颈。LLM有潜力辅助域模型构建，其中域修复(根据正/负测试计划修改PDDL)是一个有前景的方向。本文旨在评估纯LLM方法能否独立完成域修复任务，以及其是否足够可靠。
AI.method: 本研究采用LLM-only方法，评估14个开源LLM在12个IPC域(注入随机错误)上的修复能力。设计了两种提示变体：NoTrace(仅提供有缺陷的PDDL域)和WithTrace(额外提供正/负测试轨迹)。评估指标包括精确率(Pr)、召回率(Re)、F₁分数和测试通过率(TR)，并对比了基于条件命中集的符号基线算法。
AI.result: 结果显示：(1)最佳LLM(GLM 5.2在NoTrace+高推理强度)达到F₁=.87，远超符号基线的F₁=.49；(2)但其平均TR仅为0.82，在Thoughtful域上TR仅0.06；(3)最佳的WithTrace配置(DeepSeek V4 Pro+高推理)TR达0.92，但仍不完整，Thoughtful域TR仍仅为0.06；(4)测试轨迹的提供并不一致地改善F₁；(5)高推理强度对部分模型有帮助但效果因模型而异。
AI.conclusion: 当前开源LLM虽能改善语义修复质量（与ground-truth修复吻合度更高），但无法可靠地解决修复问题，因为每个测试都必须通过。作者主张采用混合方法：LLM用于排序或筛选语义候选，符号组件提供理论测试满足保证。此外，鉴于基准来自公开IPC域，可能存在训练数据污染，结论在未见过的域上的泛化性仍需验证。

title: Cognitive Graph Intelligence for Adaptive and Robust DDoS Attack Detection in Next Generation Networks
summary: Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks threaten network availability, requiring a cognitive detection process that senses traffic, infers intent, and supports an adaptive response under severe class imbalance and non-stationary conditions. This paper proposes a Graph-based Generative Adversarial Network (GraphGAN) that serves as the cognitive detection engine for this task. GraphGAN captures the relational structure among traffic flows while addressing imbalance through adversarial generation of synthetic samples. Sequential flows are converted into $k$-nearest neighbor graphs using sliding windows to preserve feature-similarity and temporal dependencies among flows. The generator learns the distribution of DDoS attacks to synthesize realistic minority samples, while a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN)-based discriminator distinguishes real from synthetic graph data. A separate GCN classifier, trained on the balanced dataset, performs the final detection decision. Evaluations on four benchmark datasets show that GraphGAN achieves superior accuracy, precision, and recall compared to state-of-the-art approaches, particularly in data-scarce scenarios. By integrating temporal graph construction, adversarial augmentation, and GCN classification, GraphGAN effectively models coordinated attack behaviors and mitigates class imbalance, providing a robust and topology-aware solution for intrusion detection in data-constrained environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GraphGAN框架，将图神经网络（GCN）与生成对抗网络（GAN）相结合，用于下一代网络中的DDoS攻击检测。该方法通过滑动窗口构建k-近邻图捕获流量间的时序与特征相似性关系，利用GCN判别器与生成器进行对抗训练以合成拓扑感知的少数类样本缓解类别不平衡问题，最终通过GCN分类器完成DDoS检测决策。在四个公开基准数据集（CIC-IDS-2017/2018、UNSW-NB15、ToN-IoT）上的实验表明，GraphGAN在准确率、精确率、召回率上均优于现有SOTA方法，尤其在数据稀缺和极端类别不平衡场景下优势显著。
AI.motivation: 现代DDoS攻击呈现出多向量、分布式、协同化的特征，传统基于签名的NIDS和统计异常检测方法难以应对。同时，网络流量具有非欧几里得的图结构特征（流之间的时序关联与特征相似性），而现有方法通常将流量视为独立特征向量，忽略了这种关系结构。此外，实际网络流量存在严重的类别不平衡问题（正常流量远多于攻击流量），导致模型对少数类敏感度不足。如何同时建模流量的拓扑结构与缓解类别不平衡，是实现自适应、鲁棒DDoS检测的关键挑战。
AI.method: GraphGAN框架包含三个核心组件：（1）图构建模块：使用滑动窗口（w=30, s=10）将连续网络流分段，基于特征空间的欧氏距离构建对称k-NN图（k=5），通过多数投票为每个子图分配标签；（2）对抗学习模块：生成器采用4层全连接网络（带BN、Dropout、tanh输出）从高斯噪声合成节点特征；GCN判别器（3层）区分真实与合成图，依据GAN原始minimax目标进行对抗训练（理论分析了最优判别器、全局最优性、拓扑独立生成的残差散度及泛化间隙）；（3）GCN分类器：采用与判别器相同的3层GCN架构，经全局均值池化后通过softmax输出二分类结果，使用交叉熵损失在增强后的平衡数据集上训练。理论层面给出了k-NN图的对称性与有界度性质、多数投票标签一致性、图结构优于单流预测的充分条件（特征模糊性与协同性）、以及基于Ben-David域自适应界的泛化保证。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上的测试准确率：GraphGAN分别达到CIC-IDS-2017 95.31%、CIC-IDS-2018 94.87%、UNSW-NB15 93.42%、ToN-IoT 94.56%，均优于对比方法（包括CNN、GRU-BiLSTM、SMOTE、WGAN、VAE-GAN、DDP-DAR、E-GraphSAGE、BS-GAT、Ensemble GNN等），其中比最强基线Ensemble GNN高2.76–3.64个百分点。关键消融实验结论：（1）类别不平衡比为1:20时，GraphGAN相比无增强基线提升22.24个百分点（89.47% vs 67.23%），随机增强仅提升2.91个百分点；（2）k-NN图构建优于全连接、阈值图和随机图；（3）最优超参数为k=5、w=30、s=10、3层GCN、全局均值池化、128维噪声；（4）4层生成器产生最佳合成质量（判别器对合成样本检测率为45.3%，接近随机猜测）；（5）训练数据比例从10%到90%的实验中，GraphGAN在低数据场景下优势最显著。
AI.conclusion: GraphGAN通过统一结构感知建模与生成式增强，有效应对DDoS检测中的类别不平衡和数据稀缺问题。其核心贡献在于：（1）基于滑动窗口的k-NN时序图构建策略捕获流量协同关系；（2）将GCN与对抗训练融合实现拓扑条件化的合成样本生成；（3）通过理论分析严格刻画了图结构的信息优势与对抗增强的泛化保证。实验在四个基准数据集上验证了方法的SOTA性能，并证明了其在极端不平衡和低数据场景下的鲁棒性。局限性包括对图构建中特征相似性假设的依赖以及对抗训练的内在不稳定性。未来工作方向涵盖多向量攻击分类、层次图结构、联邦学习框架、可解释威胁归因及加密流量分析等。

title: LEGO-RL: Harness-Native Reinforcement Learning for Coding Agents
comment: Webpage: this https URL
summary: Reinforcement learning for coding agents increasingly relies on long-running agent harnesses to manage tool integration, repository contexts, and execution feedback. However, the native execution environments of these harnesses are inherently misaligned with policy-gradient training: environmental crashes and reward hacking corrupt outcome signals, while train-inference discrepancies decouple rollout behavior from policy updates. To address this, we present LEGO-RL, a framework that bridges native coding-agent harnesses with scalable policy-gradient optimization without modifying their internal control flow. LEGO-RL is built upon three pillars: (1) faithful optimization via in-process LLM proxying that captures raw generation streams for token-level alignment and robust trainer-side log-probability recomputation, even under harness-side compaction or re-serialization; (2) reliable execution via scalable sandbox orchestration featuring image caching and stage-wise defenses to mitigate reward hacking; and (3) observable training through an integrated plugin that automates validation and monitoring, paired with a Live UI for granular trajectory diagnostics. We evaluate LEGO-RL by training the sparse MoE model Qwen3.5-35B-A3B with GSPO across three native coding-agent harnesses. LEGO-RL improves Qwen3.5-35B-A3B across OpenHands SDK (64.0% to 70.4%), Claude Code (62.4% to 68.2%), and OpenCode (57.2% to 66.6%) on SWE-bench Verified, while maintaining a rollout-training probability correlation above 0.99.

AI.tldr: LEGO-RL 是一个将原生编码智能体（coding-agent）框架与可扩展策略梯度优化直接对接的强化学习训练框架，通过三大支柱——忠实优化（in-process LLM 代理）、可靠执行（沙箱编排与图像缓存）、可观测训练（Live UI）——在不改写智能体内部控制流的前提下，实现跨 OpenHands SDK、Claude Code、OpenCode 三种 harness 的可扩展训练。使用 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B + GSPO 在 SWE-bench Verified 上分别取得 +6.4、+5.8、+9.4 的绝对提升，rollout–training 概率相关性保持 >0.99。
AI.motivation: 1. 编码智能体 RL 依赖长时运行的 harness 管理工具、仓库与执行反馈，但其原生执行环境与策略梯度训练存在错位：环境崩溃与 reward hacking 污染结果信号；train-inference 不一致使 rollout 行为与策略更新解耦。2. 通用 RL 框架（如 verl、slime、SkyRL）通常要求将智能体适配到框架定义的 rollout 接口，而 harness-native 路线在可扩展执行、奖励完整性保护与轨迹级诊断方面仍不充分。3. 稀疏 MoE 模型在 rollout 与训练时若专家路由不一致，会进一步破坏忠实优化。
AI.method: 围绕三大支柱设计：(1) 忠实优化——在模型服务边界部署 in-process 代理，捕获原始 token 流、log-prob、response mask 与生成元数据；对 harness 的 history 重写/压缩按消息粒度对齐，工具调用按稳定标识符匹配；为稀疏 MoE 通过 R3 回放 rollout 时的专家路由决策。(2) 可靠执行——基于 Kubernetes/Docker 的可扩展沙箱编排，使用 Nydus 懒加载快照流式拉取镜像、只读挂载智能体运行时与评分工具链、按阶段设置超时、终止感知过滤，将基础设施失败屏蔽出 group-relative 优化；同时实施六类 reward-integrity 防御（侧车网络隔离、历史 rebase、测试延迟注入、verifier 审计等）。(3) 可观测训练——通过 Agent Plugin 自动化运行验证、训练调度与监控；Live UI 提供终止原因、逐实例任务网格、轨迹查看、rollout–training 一致性面板与 AI 辅助诊断。底层依托 verl（PPO/GRPO/GSPO/vLLM）与 Harbor（任务与沙箱定义），支持 VeOmni/FSDP/Megatron 后端及全异步训练（最大策略滞后为 1）。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B + GSPO、200k token 上下文、2699 任务训练池、3 epoch 的统一协议下：(1) SWE-bench Verified 解决率——OpenHands SDK 64.0→70.4（+6.4）、Claude Code 62.4→68.2（+5.8）、OpenCode 57.2→66.6（+9.4），同模型跨 harness 的 step-0 起点不同且改进以各自基线衡量；并超过新一代基座 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（+3.0/+4.8/+6.0）及 KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev。(2) 忠实性——三个 harness 的 rollout–train Pearson 相关性中位数 ≥0.998、任一步骤不低于 0.989，p99 平均 log-prob 差 <3×10⁻³；启用 R3 路由回放将相关性由 0.9946 提升至 0.9993、|Δp| 由 0.0062 降至 0.0025，专家重叠 0.996、top-1 一致 0.985。(3) 系统效率——agent 执行占总试次耗时 91.3%（840.5/920.4 s）；同步 vs 异步同条件下 7.5 小时内完成 3 vs 7 步（2.5× 加速）；Nydus 懒拉取冷启动中位 1.7×、最大 23×，网络流量 21.6 GB→1.59 GB、磁盘写 65.6 GB→5.29 GB；预构建任务镜像 33.2× 加速沙箱启动，挂载智能体运行时 15.4× 加速 agent 设置。(4) 奖励完整性——约 2.5% 任务存在 verifier 错误应用参考 patch；关闭测试/历史 rebase/侧车隔离后，相关失败模式发生率从 1.9–20.5% 降至可控。(5) 行为分析——OpenHands SDK 中"编辑后回读文件"由 73.6% 升至 98.1%，探索文件数 3.45→6.92，pass@8 由 83.2% 升至 87.9%。
AI.conclusion: LEGO-RL 通过"harness-native"路线，证明无需改写智能体内部控制流即可将原生编码智能体接入可扩展策略梯度训练，核心是将忠实优化、可靠执行与可观测训练作为一等公民。实验显示该框架在三种主流 harness 上均带来稳定提升，并以 >0.99 的 rollout–training 一致性维持优化忠实性。作者指出当前局限：单一模型（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B）、单次运行的方差未量化、二元终局奖励粒度有限、奖励防御对未观察到的利用方式不完备；未来工作聚焦混合 harness 训练、更细粒度信用分配、Live UI 自动化诊断及持续开源生态建设。

title: Task-Aware Harness Provisioning for LLM Agents in Mission-Critical Infrastructure Operations
summary: LLM agents have been widely adopted to operate mission-critical infrastructure (MCI). These agents normally rely on a harness that determines what information they can access, which tools they can use, and what actions they can take. Existing systems often expose the same comprehensive harness to every task, which may not be necessary and cause resource wastes. In this paper, we focus on the identification of optimal harness configurations, and view it as a resource-matching problem between what each task requires and what the harness provides. To measure this match, we classify MCI tasks based on the mathematical representation of the underlying system and rank harness configurations by the amount and type of information they provide. We then construct task-to-harness mappings from two sources: mining research literature and measuring controlled agent execution. Leveraging the measured mapping, we propose a new harness provisioning algorithm: map-guided escalation. It begins with a task-specific harness and expands to full provision only after a failed self-check. We evaluate our method in two representative MCI tasks: in liquid cooling, it improves the agent accuracy from 0.652 under full provision to 0.715 and achieves accuracy comparable to Reflexion with 48% fewer tokens; In power grids, full provision remains accuracy-optimal, while map-based provisioning offers lower-cost alternatives. These findings show that harness provisioning follows a domain-dependent accuracy-cost Pareto frontier rather than a universal optimum.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将LLM智能体在关键基础设施(MCI)中的harness配置问题建模为资源匹配问题，通过基于物理系统数学表示的12类任务分类法和5级递进式harness层次，构建文献驱动与执行驱动的任务-harness映射，并提出"映射引导升级"策略(Map-ESC)，在液冷和电网两个领域证明harness配置存在领域依赖的精度-成本帕累托前沿而非通用最优解。
AI.motivation: 现有MCI运维系统普遍采用"一刀切"的全量harness配置，为每个任务提供相同的信息、工具和操作权限，导致资源浪费、成本增加和不必要的信息暴露。论文试图回答核心问题：能否为给定任务确定维持可靠执行所需的最小harness配置？
AI.method: 1) 基于物理系统数学表示(x_{t+1}=F(x_t,a_t,d_t)+ξ_t, y_t=G(x_t)+ε_t)构建12类任务空间(输出模式ω∈{Inform,Act} × 时间τ∈{t,t+Δ} × 目标元素e∈{y,x,m})；2) 定义5级递进式harness层次(K1纯模型推理→K2静态知识→K3时序观测→K4结构与物理→K5前向仿真)；3) 通过挖掘1200+篇文献构建文献驱动映射，通过在240个仿真验证任务上全层级扫描构建执行驱动映射；5) 提出Map-ESC算法：先用映射级别初始化harness，自检失败时升级至K5。
AI.result: 在液冷领域：Map-ESC将准确率从0.652提升至0.715，token成本仅1.15×全量；Exec-Lookup用0.86×token达到0.670准确率；达到Reflexion同等准确率但少用48%token。在电网领域：全量K5仍为精度最优(0.806)，Exec-Lookup提供低成本的0.762精度替代。跨执行器迁移实验显示GPT-5.4构建的映射迁移到Qwen3.5-27B仍有效(液冷0.706→0.726)。harness需求存在领域依赖的精度-成本帕累托前沿而非通用最优。
AI.conclusion: harness配置应作为可测量的部署决策，基于任务类别和领域需求进行选择，而非默认授予最大信息、工具和操作权限。执行证据比文献先验更能校准映射，且该映射可跨执行器迁移。测量harness需求（即映射本身）比执行端自适应方法(Reflexion/ExpeL)在精度-效率权衡上更具优势。

title: Depth Enables Local Entropy: Quadratic Depth Dependence in Deep Variation-Norm ReLU Regression
summary: We study Gaussian regression over the explicit vector-valued Parhi--Nowak deep-RBV^2 architecture with depth L, width w, layer-sum variation budget A, and output bound B. For this O(L w^2)-parameterized architecture, the known lower and upper bounds differ by one factor of depth. We construct a local packing showing that the quadratic depth dependence is intrinsic under an explicit sample-size-dependent radius condition. The packing has log-cardinality Omega(L^2 w^2 log w); its codewords lie in an O(lambda) L^2 ball and are pairwise Omega(lambda)-separated. The main ingredients are a bias-corrected bounded-coefficient approximation theorem and balanced amplification: multiplying a depth-D ReLU network by q can be implemented using one constant channel so that every coefficient grows by only q^(1/D). Translation to vector-valued RBV^2 blocks then has layer-sum cost O(D w^2 q^(1/D)). Gaussian Fano yields a radius-explicit lower bound governed by the output, testing, and representation scales. Under A=B=R, sigma proportional to R, and the stated radius condition, this gives minimax risk at least of order L^2 w^2 log(w) R^2/n. A pseudodimension-based finite-net upper bound gives O-tilde(L^2 w^2 R^2/n) for unbounded Gaussian responses. Thus the minimax risk has quadratic polynomial dependence on depth, up to logarithmic factors, and exhibits a transition to representation-limited behavior at smaller radius.

AI.tldr: 本文研究向量值Parhi–Nowak深度RBV²架构（深度L、宽度w，层和变化预算A，输出界B）上的高斯回归，参数规模为O(Lw²)。通过构造一个大小为exp(Ω(L²w²log w))的局部填充，证明在显式样本量依赖的半径条件下，minimax风险对深度L呈现二次多项式依赖，与之前的O(Lw²)下界相比多了一个L因子。下界和上界（通过伪维数有限网得到）匹配至对数因子。此外，论文推导了由输出上限、高斯检验尺度和表示限制尺度三种约束之间的竞争。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在许多任务上表现出深度带来的组合性优势，但这种深度是否在统计复杂度（而非仅仅是参数计数）中带来额外的因子一直未被明确。Ganguli和Constantinescu (2026) 在O(Lw²)参数化下得到了Ω(Lw²R²/n) ≤ R_n* ≤ Õ(L²w²R²/n)的不匹配上下界。核心问题：额外的L因子是证明伪影还是反映了深度真正能解码的信息？本文旨在通过构造局部函数空间码（而非精化上界）来证明二次深度依赖是内在的。
AI.method: 核心技术包括：(1) 偏置修正的有界系数逼近定理——通过添加常数同质坐标修正Ou等人(2024)的位提取构造，使得qN可在深度D、宽度m+1下实现，系数仅增长q^{1/D}；(2) 平衡放大引理——将增益分布在整个深度而非浓缩在单层，使得变换到向量值RBV²块的层和成本为O(Dw²q^{1/D})而非常数q；(3) 通过parhi-Nowak范数和帐篷映射将局部码嵌入到圆形域上；(4) 通过高斯Fano不等式结合三个约束（输出界、检验尺度、表示尺度）推导下界；(5) 利用Bartlett等人(2019)的分段线性伪维数定理给出上界。
AI.result: 主要定理结果：在A=B=R、σ≍R、n≥M且满足半径条件R^{D-1}≥(C_rad Dw²)^D M^{3/2}/√n时，下界为R_n*(R,R,σ) ≥ cL²w²log(w)R²/n；上界为R_n* ≤ CL²w²log(Lw)log(en)R²/n。因此minimax风险对深度L具有二次多项式依赖（至对数因子）。半径显式下界为R_n* ≥ c·min{B, σ√(M/n), (1/M)·((A-C₀)+/(C_tr Dw²))^D}²。论文还识别出三种相变：输出受限、统计受限（λ_stat主导）和表示受限（λ_rep主导）尺度。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明在向量值Parhi–Nowak深度RBV²架构中，minimax风险对深度L二次依赖是内在的而非证明伪影，而非之前Ganguli-Constantinescu工作中假设的线性依赖。关键方法论贡献是在该架构内构造了一个局部填充，其对数基数为Ω(L²w²log w)，且所有码字位于O(λ)L²球内并被Ω(λ)分隔。二次深度项的来源识别为有序对结构（一个扰动层加一个下游放大层）。论文还揭示了三种半径相变模式，强调小层和预算可按指数方式折叠函数类。开放问题包括：消除log w与log(Lw)log n之间的对数间隙；在所有A值下建立锐利的A依赖上界；有限精度参数类的不同行为。

title: Structure-Internalized Rule Language Model for Faithful Knowledge Graph Reasoning
summary: Knowledge Graph Reasoning (KGR) aims to discover latent facts by leveraging the structural evidence available in KGs, posing a challenge to the structural semantic understanding capability of KGR models. Recent studies have demonstrated that Large Language Models (LLMs) can achieve remarkable progress on KGR tasks via flexible in-context learning. However, the inherent representation inconsistency between KG structural context and LLM parametric knowledge remains inadequately addressed. This limitation prevents LLMs from effectively perceiving reasoning evidence that aligns with KG constraints, which undermines both the effectiveness and faithfulness of reasoning. We refer to this problem as reasoning evidence perception drift of LLMs over KGs. To address this problem, we propose a Structure-Internalized Rule Language Model (SIRLM), which centers on structural rule generation to couple the parametric learning of structural knowledge with the faithfulness evaluation of reasoning logic, enabling LLMs to anchor tightly to KG-grounded evidence. Specifically, we first design a Structure-Internalized Rule Generator (SIRG), which incorporates an in-context learning block augmented with a structural relation memory to coordinate structural and parametric knowledge. Furthermore, we equip SIRG with a KG tokenizer based on structural invariance learning and a neuro-symbolic reasoner based on rule-constrained message propagation. These components provide SIRG with learnable structural representations and faithful rule-execution feedback, respectively. Our SIRLM can be seamlessly integrated into standard LLM training paradigms, such as SFT and GRPO. Extensive experiments against 17 state-of-the-art KGR methods on 36 datasets demonstrate the significant superiority of SIRLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SIRLM（Structure-Internalized Rule Language Model），针对大语言模型在知识图谱推理（KGR）任务中出现的"推理证据感知漂移"问题（即 LLM 因参数化知识与 KG 结构知识之间的表示不一致而倾向于依据预训练语义偏好选取证据，而非严格遵循 KG 结构约束），通过结构内化规则生成，将结构知识的参数化学习与推理逻辑的忠实性评估耦合。在 36 个数据集上与 17 种基线方法的对比实验表明，SIRLM 在转导式和归纳式 KGR 场景下均取得显著优势。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM-based KGR 方法存在表征不一致问题：LLM 倾向于基于预训练语义偏好而非 KG 结构约束来选择推理证据，导致生成语义上合理但难以在 KG 中落地的推理逻辑。作者将此问题定义为"推理证据感知漂移"，并指出这损害了推理的有效性与忠实性。此外，现有方法对归纳式（尤其是 FullInd）场景泛化能力不足，且难以处理匿名化关系路径。
AI.method: 方法核心为 SIRLM，包含三大模块：(1) 基于结构不变性学习（SIL）的 KG tokenizer，将 KG 元素编码为通用结构表征的新 token；(2) 结构内化规则生成器 SIRG，采用带结构关系记忆（SRM）的 in-context learning 块来协调结构与参数化知识，通过自回归"下一关系预测"生成可执行规则；(3) 基于规则约束消息传播（RCMP）的神经符号推理器，将规则隐藏态作为关系图节点的初始化信号注入 NBFNet，形成忠实性反馈闭环。训练上无缝集成 SFT 与 GRPO 框架。理论上证明 SRM 模块提升了结构对齐并抑制语义漂移，RCMP 是两阶段 WL 测试对 SIL 的严格精化。
AI.result: 在 36 个 KGR 数据集（含转导式 4 个、IndE 12 个、FullInd 20 个）上与 17 种基线（含嵌入方法、规则方法、GNN 方法及 LLM 方法如 NBFNet、MOTIF、KRLM 等）对比，SIRLM 在 MRR 和 Hit10 上均取得最优或接近最优表现。相较最优基线，FullInd 场景下 MRR 提升约 10.30%、Hit10 提升约 12.05%；四种训练模式（E2E、PT、SFT、GRPO）均表现稳定。消融实验验证 MMQI、SRM、RCMP 三模块均不可或缺，其中 SRM 和 RCMP 对性能影响最大。指令长度仅 50.73，远低于 MKGL（115.66）与 KRLM（120.50），计算开销与显存占用亦显著低于 KRLM。
AI.conclusion: SIRLM 有效缓解了 LLM 在 KGR 中的证据感知漂移问题，将结构规则生成作为对齐 LLM 参数化知识与 KG 结构证据的桥梁，实现了忠实且可解释的 KG 推理。其在多种训练范式和 LLM backbone（Qwen2.5、Llama-2 系列 0.5B–7B）下均表现鲁棒，具备跨场景泛化能力。未来工作将引入查询驱动的证据图提取机制降低计算复杂度，并在稀疏 KG 场景中结合软规则挖掘扩展监督信号。

title: SAGE: Self-Evolving Storyboard Skills via Attribution-Guided Rule Evolution
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Dataset available at this https URL
summary: Storyboards turn screenplays into visual shot plans for automated short drama production. Professional storyboarding relies on tacit directorial expertise and remains an industrial bottleneck. Large language models can automate this step, but methods for supplying directing knowledge face three challenges: (1) Knowledge acquisition: the craft remains implicit in exemplars or must be written manually. (2) Knowledge refinement: authored knowledge is not evaluated against execution outcomes, and opaque generation prevents feedback attribution to the knowledge behind each decision. (3) Knowledge injection: injecting all knowledge exceeds usable context, while manual selection for every narrative group does not scale. We present SAGE (Skill with Attribution-Guided Evolution), a deployed framework that learns, attributes, evolves, and routes directing knowledge from expert demonstrations. SAGE derives rules that are independent of episode content by contrasting each training screenplay with its expert storyboard. During generation, the model records each narrative group's adopted rules. Combining these records with localized feedback enables targeted updates to individual rules. Evolved rules form scenario packages with a routing index, so each group retrieves only a bounded set appropriate to its situation without expert intervention. On 18 test episodes across three genres, SAGE scored 77.8 on a rubric validated by experts, versus 77.1 for professional directors. Deployed for 14 days on Virtual Film Studio, SAGE produced 1,344 narrative group outputs; 87.2 percent were accepted without substantive edits, and the production team recorded over 83 percent less authoring time per episode. We release PROSE, the first public dataset pairing screenplays with storyboards by professional directors across 68 episodes: this https URL .

AI.tldr: SAGE是一个用于短剧分镜生成的自动进化框架，通过规则级归因从专业导演演示中学习、更新和路由导演知识，解决了知识获取、知识优化和知识注入三大挑战，在18集测试集上达到77.8分（专业导演77.1分），并在实际生产部署中减少83%的创作时间。同时发布了PROSE数据集，包含68集专业导演分镜。
AI.motivation: 短剧产业产能瓶颈：手工分镜依赖隐性导演专业知识（每集需超1小时），而现有LLM自动化方法在镜头语言上缺乏专业能力，且面临三大挑战——知识隐式或需手工编写、知识无法针对执行反馈优化、全部注入超出可用上下文。这一瓶颈限制了自动化短剧生产的大规模落地。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1)进化阶段——通过对比剧本与专家分镜提取内容无关的规则，在T轮迭代中记录每个叙事组采用的规则（rule-adoption records），将局部反馈与采用记录连接实现规则级归因，区分失误规则（修订）、覆盖缺口（新增）和未使用规则（淘汰），每轮修改上限30%；(2)整合阶段——用两阶段并查集去重，基于条件嵌入进行UMAP降维与k-means聚类，形成场景包（scenario packages）并附加路由索引；(3)推理阶段——通过top-k路由为每个叙事组检索匹配的场景包，并行生成分镜段。形式上将规则集视为可学习的自然语言参数，将对齐分数f_align视为训练目标。
AI.result: 在18集三类型测试集上：SAGE总分为77.8，超过专业导演（77.1），是唯一超越导演基线的AI系统；视觉描述维度达85.1（导演75.1）；消融显示归因机制贡献2.4分，无归因迭代在第3轮达峰后衰减至起始点以下；规则集在GPT-5.4、GLM-5.2、DeepSeek V4-Pro三个其他骨干模型上保持8.1%-21.2%的相对提升；VFS平台14天部署中1344个叙事组输出87.2%免实质修改，制作时间从超1小时降至约10分钟；评估器与三位人类导演的一致性（CCC均值0.806）超过人际一致性（0.699）。
AI.conclusion: 规则级归因粒度决定了自然语言知识进化能否收敛：从剧集级反馈到规则级信用的转变使迭代从扰动变为优化，这一架构要求超越了分镜领域，适用于任何能声明其所消费知识的生成流水线。SAGE首次在规则粒度上实现可进化技能的知识库，跨越了进化、整合和部署全流程，并已在商业生产中运行。PROSE数据集填补了从专家演示而非逆向工程视频的分镜-剧本配对资源的空白。

title: When AI Designs AI: Innovation or Imitation?
summary: Recent advances in LLM agents have made them increasingly capable of designing methods for complex AI tasks. This raises two central questions about agent-designed methods relative to human-designed methods: how well they perform, and how different their algorithmic designs are. To study these questions, this paper introduces an analysis that derives task-specific algorithmic design spaces from human-designed methods, maps both human- and agent-designed methods into these spaces, and quantifies their algorithmic differences at the module level. Widely used LLM agents are evaluated on a suite of representative, open-ended AI tasks spanning multiple modalities, and the methods they design are analyzed in terms of both task performance and algorithmic differences from human-designed methods. Experimental results show that current agents can occasionally match or surpass human state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance (10/72 configurations), but such success does not generalize reliably across tasks or agents. Moreover, 96.8% of agent-designed methods fall within human-derived algorithmic design spaces, largely recombining algorithmic choices found in human-designed methods, while nearly half exactly match an existing human algorithmic design. Taken together, these findings suggest that although current agents can occasionally match or surpass human SOTA performance, their algorithmic designs remain within human-derived algorithmic design spaces, reflecting the reuse and recombination of algorithmic choices.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了主流LLM智能体在多模态开放性AI任务上自主设计方法的能力,从性能表现和算法设计差异两个维度,与人类设计方法进行对比分析,发现当前智能体偶尔能匹敌甚至超越人类SOTA,但其算法设计基本仍是在人类方案空间内的重组与模仿。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体评估基准多以最终任务性能为指标,缺乏对其方法背后算法选择的洞察;且部分任务解决方案路径受限或性能接近饱和,难以支撑充分的开放性算法探索。本文旨在回答两个核心问题:(1)智能体自主设计的方法相对人类设计方法性能如何;(2)二者在算法设计上有多大差异——是真正创新还是仅在模仿。
AI.method: 提出一种基于"任务特定算法设计空间"的统一分析方法:(1)构建涵盖多模态的代表性开放性AI任务套件,并附带人类SOTA排行榜及参考论文/代码;(2)采用人机协作流程,从人类参考方法中提炼出任务特定的算法设计空间(以有向无环图表示数据流,节点对应算法模块,边表示模块依赖);(3)将人类方法和智能体方法映射为同一空间内的"算法坐标"(Algorithmic Coordinate);(4)以模块级的Hamming距离量化二者差异;(5)结合任务专属评估器衡量性能,从性能与算法差异两个维度联合分析。
AI.result: 实验覆盖6个任务、72个评测配置:仅10/72配置中智能体能达到或超过人类SOTA,且集中在3/6的任务上,泛化性较差;96.8%的智能体设计方法落在人类派生的算法设计空间内,近半数与某个人类方法完全相同;超70%与最近的人类方法在至多一个模块上有差异。同时观察到智能体研究的若干共性模式:对外部知识利用有限、对算法设计空间的探索有限、以及对集成预测(ensemble)有强烈偏好。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM智能体虽然偶尔能触及人类性能前沿,但其算法设计仍局限于人类已建立的设计空间内,本质上是对既有算法选择的复用与局部重组,缺乏真正意义上的算法创新。这一发现对评估智能体的研究能力、改进其探索机制以及推动真正自主科研进展具有重要启示意义。

title: Towards Better Agents for Multi-Turn User Interaction: The Next User Turn Is More Than Context
summary: User-facing tool agents must coordinate dialogue and tool use as user goals unfold over multiple turns. Yet interactive reinforcement learning typically reduces each rollout to a terminal reward, assigning the same credit to effective elicitation, errors, and later repair. The next user turn is more than context: it also provides noisy, temporally local evidence about the preceding user-to-user segment. We introduce \textbf{F}eedback-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{C}redit \textbf{A}ssignment (\textsc{FACA}), which aligns each reaction with that segment, derives a locally normalized reaction advantage, and adds it to verified terminal outcome advantage without an extra critic or rollout. Against an outcome-only Interactive GRPO control matched in simulator, visible dialogue, initialization, rollout, and optimization, \textsc{FACA} improves the nine-domain $\tau$-family average across three independently trained runs by 5.91 and 10.22 percentage points at 8B and 14B, respectively. Gains concentrate in Telecom; at 8B, randomizing reaction polarity removes the Telecom gain. The same ordering holds zero-shot on Pare-Bench and Co-Gym. These results demonstrate that next-turn user reactions provide actionable local credit for improving multi-turn user-interacting agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FACA（Feedback-Aware Credit Assignment），将用户下一轮的反应作为多轮交互智能体中前一个U2U（user-to-user）片段的局部信用信号，与最终结果优势相加进行强化学习训练，无需额外评论家或回滚，在τ-bench系列基准上较纯结果的Interactive GRPO基线提升5.91/10.22个百分点（8B/14B），且在Telecom域提升最显著，零样本迁移至Pare-Bench和Co-Gym仍保持优势。
AI.motivation: 多轮交互式强化学习中，传统的outcome-only信用分配方法将整条对话压缩为单一的终局奖励，导致有效澄清、错误和后续修复获得相同的优势信号——奖励只说明"是否成功"，不说明"在哪一步转向"。然而用户的下一轮回复不仅为后续决策提供上下文，事后还可作为对前一个agent片段的时序局部证据（提供信息、批准、拒绝或纠错），这部分信号在纯结果训练中完全被浪费。如何利用这种过程性证据来改善局部信用分配同时不破坏任务完成的最终目标，是核心问题。
AI.method: FACA的核心方法包含三个层面：（1）将相邻两轮用户消息之间agent产生的所有消息和工具调用定义为一个U2U片段；（2）冻结的用户模拟器在每轮同时输出可见话语和私有策略标签（reveal_piece/confirm/close为+1，be_vague/invalid为0，ask_clarification/challenge_solution/change_mind为-1），将该策略映射为三元极性并与紧邻其前的U2U片段对齐；（3）在prompt与U2U序数索引构成的局部比较集内做z-score归一化得到过程优势A^p，加权λ后与终局结果优势A^o相加得到最终优势A=A^o+λA^p，仅广播给agent语言和工具调用token。整个流程复用同一rollout，无需评论家、无需额外模拟、无需将标签暴露给agent。λ在主实验中固定为0.5以限制代理信号的主导地位。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B和14B（用MUA-RL数据SFT初始化）上、三个独立训练种子、step-120检查点上：FACA较严格匹配的Interactive GRPO基线在九域τ-family平均上分别提升5.91和10.22个百分点，所有种子、所有规模均保持正向排序；最大提升集中在Telecom域（8B的τ² Telecom从30.7升至41.2，14B从26.3升至83.6）；消融实验显示随机化反应极性或偏移对齐均消除Telecom增益，验证信号需要时序对齐和语义内容；零样本迁移到Pare-Bench（Pass@1从6.29%→10.49%/10.49%→13.29%）和Co-Gym（16个scale-metric单元中13个领先）同样保持排序优势；轨迹级审计显示FACA在τ² Telecom配对McNemar p=5.80×10⁻¹⁵。反应可观察性（feedback-rich的交替控制场景）而非交互长度是收益的决定因素。
AI.conclusion: FACA证明了用户下一轮反应可作为多轮交互智能体中可操作的局部信用信号，无需评论家、额外回滚或向agent暴露标签，在保留终局任务监督的同时改善局部信用分配；效果在8B/14B两个规模上稳健，且在反馈丰富的Telecom类任务中增益最大，在两个零样本协议上保留排序优势；然而收益具有条件性，依赖反应对前序片段具有信息性而非所有交互场景普适，且目前依赖冻结模拟器的私有策略标注，向真实用户部署的扩展仍是开放问题。

title: SGHA: Evidence-Grounded Research Problem Discovery with Local Language Models
comment: Link to Code and artifacts: this https URL
summary: Recent efforts toward fully automated AI scientists have demonstrated that language-model agents can generate hypotheses, execute experiments, and draft scientific manuscripts. However, during the early stages of research, when research problems are formulated, these AI scientists often rely heavily on proprietary frontier models. Their proposals are shaped by opaque parametric knowledge and by literature searches conditioned on the proposals themselves. Such knowledge is effectively a black box, and this dependence makes the evidential basis and validity of generated research problems difficult to audit and leaves the process vulnerable to model-specific hallucinations and biases. Furthermore, if proprietary research materials are transmitted to external APIs, the use of these models creates confidentiality, privacy, and data-governance concerns. We introduce the Structural Gap Hypothesis Agent (SGHA), a fully automated, corpus-first research-problem discovery system that runs entirely on a local LLM. SGHA structures a scientific literature corpus into evidence-linked paper objects and a typed evidence graph, detects unresolved structural patterns across papers, screens candidate gaps before formulation, and produces traceable research-problem families. In particular, it is able to output assumptions, objectives, success criteria, and remaining ambiguities. All LLM-based components of SGHA are executed using a locally served open-weight 9B language model, without requiring proprietary frontier-model APIs. We compare SGHA with the AI Scientist-v2 idea formulation module in five machine-learning domains. Our results suggest that explicit corpus structure and evidence-constrained reasoning can support promising, inspectable research-problem formulation without relying on frontier models during generation or verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SGHA（Structural Gap Hypothesis Agent），一种基于本地开源 LLM 的、以文献语料为先的研究问题自动发现系统。它通过构建类型化证据图检测跨论文未解决的"结构性缺口"，经过验证门控和批评筛选后生成可追溯、可形式化的研究问题族，无需依赖专有前沿模型 API。
AI.motivation: 现有全自动 AI 科学家系统在研究问题提出阶段严重依赖专有前沿大模型（如 GPT-4、Claude），存在三大问题：(1) 参数化知识不透明、证据基础难以审计；(2) 文献检索以假设为条件，易产生模型特有的幻觉与偏差；(3) 将未发表或敏感研究材料传输至外部 API 引发机密性、隐私和数据治理风险。论文旨在探索能否在仅使用本地开源 LLM 的前提下，从文献本身的结构性模式中发现可信的研究问题。
AI.method: SGHA 是一个训练无关的端到端流水线：(1) 证据基础构建——对选定论文进行解析与结构化抽取，生成包含方法、任务、假设、限制、失败条件等的论文级对象与 (subject, relation, object) 类型证据元组，并经确定性验证（移除泛化主体、检验源文匹配）；(2) 类型化证据图构建——将论文对象与元组插入带源溯的多类型节点/边图中；(3) 结构化 motif 检测——在图中检索预定义模式（如假设-失效、共享失效、反复未解决的局限等），生成候选缺口；(4) 验证先于形式化——通过语料新颖性筛选与多角色代理（支持者、怀疑者、可行性、机制、批评者）的硬性验证门控（survival score ≥ 0.60、批评者非拒绝等确定性条件）过滤；(5) 直接形式化 → 受控雄心扩展（保守/广义/大胆三变体）→ 独立批评者拒绝空泛扩展 → 项目族合并；(6) 半形式化问题对象生成，包含变量表、假设状态、成功标准、风险、歧义标记与逐段源溯。系统还支持研究者画像条件化生成与图变异式进化探索分支。全部 LLM 组件使用本地部署的 Qwen3.5-9B 模型。
AI.result: 在 5 个 ML 领域（bandits、in-context learning、reasoning/test-time computation、offline RL、uncertainty estimation）共 1,250 篇选定论文上，SGHA 从 1,044 篇成功抽取 8,634 个证据元组，经 motif 检测得到 836 个候选缺口，105 个通过新颖性筛选，64 个被评审，39 个通过硬验证门控，最终产生 19 个被批评者接受的变体并合并为 15 个项目族与半形式化问题陈述。在与 AI-Scientist-v2（同 Qwen 与 Claude Opus 配置）以及 MOOSE-Star 的盲法五模型评审比较中，SGHA 在总体公式化质量（5.99 vs 4.55/5.84/2.00）、源溯特异性（7.43）、假设边界清晰度（6.45）、形式化潜力（5.51）与歧义处理（7.61）上均领先；Claude Opus 在清晰度、技术特异性、非平凡性与范围控制上更强。SGHA 在结构化字段覆盖上完整（正式问题、假设、源溯、歧义标记、评估计划、风险俱全），而基线缺失正式问题对象与歧义标记。模型规模敏感性显示 4B 模型因无变体通过批评而无法产出最终族；语料规模测试表明 200 篇论文在 Bandits 上达到最佳产量。画像条件化在 LeCun/Hinton/Jordan 三组实验中获得合理的画像对齐分数；进化分支产生 2,908 个候选并产出 96 个排名假设。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明：以语料为先、证据约束的推理可以在不依赖前沿模型的前提下产生可审计、可追溯的研究问题形式化。SGHA 的核心价值不在于生成"更漂亮的提案"，而在于将文献中的假设、失效模式与未解决局限转化为结构化的研究问题族，附带显式的假设状态、成功标准与歧义标记，从而为研究者提供透明的精炼起点。SGHA 应被视为开放性构思的互补工具——当目标是从给定文献中提取已被暗示但未被显式提出的问题时尤为有效。其当前局限在于：LLM 评审无法验证外部新颖性、理论正确性或未来科学影响；半形式化陈述也非最终可证定理。文章同时指明未来方向：更大的模型与更大语料均通过验证与批评过滤影响最终输出，但 SGHA 的设计强调"以证据支持时输出问题族，否则承认低信号"，这使其与简单的扩缩式流水线有本质区别。

title: Agent Lightning v1.0: Towards Harnessed Agentic RL
summary: Modern agents operate inside agent harnesses that manage tools, context, and control flow, making the harness a critical part of the agent system. Our original Agent Lightning introduced a disaggregated architecture that connects arbitrary agents to RL training through an LLM endpoint proxy, an approach later adopted by frameworks such as verl Uni-Agent, AReaL 2.0, slime, and Polar. We refer to this paradigm as harnessed agentic RL, where the deploy-time harness directly participates in model post-training. Harnessed agentic RL differs fundamentally from traditional agentic RL: the harness, rather than the training engine, owns the environment interaction loop, while the trainer observes only sequences of LLM request-response pairs. This introduces challenges in retokenization, sample merging, advantage calculation, loss normalization, and backend scheduling, which can substantially affect training stability and effectiveness. We present Agent Lightning v1.0, a lightweight framework for harnessed agentic RL implemented in approximately 3,500 lines of code. It supports arbitrary agent harnesses and serves as a practical testbed for studying these challenges. We evaluate it on instruction-following, search, and coding agents, and provide a complete reproducible pipeline for coding-agent RL. Using only 6K training examples and modest compute, RL improves Qwen3.5-9B on SWE-bench Verified from 41.8% to 56.4%, a 14.6-point absolute gain. We release the complete workflow and training scripts to facilitate reproducible research on harnessed agentic RL.

AI.tldr: Agent Lightning v1.0 是一个轻量级（约 3,500 行代码）框架，用于支持"harness 化的 Agentic RL"训练范式——即部署时使用的 agent harness 直接参与模型后训练。该工作系统性地识别并解决了 retokenization、样本合并、优势计算、损失归一化与训练后端调度五大挑战，并仅用 6K 训练样本和适中算力，使 Qwen3.5-9B 在 SWE-bench Verified 上从 41.8% 提升至 56.4%。
AI.motivation: 传统 RL 框架（如 verl、AReaL、slime）要求在训练引擎内重写 agent loop，难以复用现成 agent harness（如 mini-SWE-agent、OpenHands、Claude Code）。基于 LLM 端点代理的解耦架构虽能解决此问题，但带来新挑战：一个 rollout 可能因 retokenization、子 agent 生成、上下文摘要等产生动态数量的训练样本，进而影响优势计算、损失归一化和后端调度的正确性与稳定性；现有框架在这些设计选择上存在分歧且缺乏系统阐述。同时，现有框架在 coding agent 上的端到端可复现训练流程稀缺。
AI.method: 1) 将 harness 化 agentic RL 形式化为 POMDP，其中 harness 拥有环境交互循环，策略模型仅观察到 (prompt, response) 调用序列。2) 提出四项设计选择：① best-effort 序列合并（仅在 token 级前缀匹配时合并以保留 rollout 实际消费 prompt）；② rollout 级优势计算（避免样本数变化扭曲基线）；③ rollout 级 token-mean 损失归一化（防止长负样本引发不稳定）；④ 固定 GPU 资源下的动态样本调度（保留 rollout 与 prompt group 标识）。3) 系统由三组件构成：API Gateway（rollout/model/event 存储 + 代理路由）、Rollout Controller（基于 Kubernetes Job 的对账循环）、Customized Trainer（基于 VERL）。4) 提出 collocated async RL，复用同一 GPU 池分时执行 rollout 与更新。5) 通过幂等 API 与重复请求去重处理网络故障；用自建 Kubernetes 替代商业沙箱服务。
AI.result: 在三种 agent 设置中均取得显著提升：搜索 agent（Llama-3.2-3B + GRPO，HotpotQA 训练）验证奖励 25.1%→41.7%（+16.6%）；通用指令遵循 agent（Qwen3-4B + RLOO）验证奖励 51.9%→70.2%（+18.3%）；编程 agent（Qwen3.5-9B + GRPO，SWE-smith 数据 + mini-SWE-agent harness）SWE-bench Verified 从 41.8% 提升至 56.4%（+14.6 绝对增益）。消融实验表明 rollout 级优势 + rollout 级归一化组合取得最高验证奖励（38.2%）和最稳定的策略熵；collocated async RL 相比同步 RL 实现约 2× 端到端加速且使用更少 GPU；每个 rollout 平均产生 2.41 个训练样本，仅 36% 保持为单样本。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统阐述了 harness 化 agentic RL 与传统 agentic RL 在潜在状态、模型输入与控制权上的本质差异，并形式化分析了因 harness 拥有交互循环而引发的五项实现挑战。Agent Lightning v1.0 以约 3,500 行代码提供了支持任意 agent harness 的紧凑可复现框架，并嵌入了 rollout 级的设计选择。实验验证了该范式在搜索、指令遵循与编程任务中的有效性，证明了在极有限资源下 RL 即可带来显著性能提升，为后续 harness 化 agentic RL 的研究提供了完整基线与开放工具链。

title: When to Review: Spaced Repetition for Continual Pre-Training of Language Models
summary: Continual pre-training of large language models must acquire new information without erasing old knowledge. Existing replay methods often choose a global old/new mixture and sample uniformly, ignoring that examples differ in how quickly they are forgotten. We formulate continual pre-training as adaptive review scheduling: the training loop should decide not only how much history to replay, but which examples should return at each step. We introduce Spaced Repetition Training (SRT), a continual learning framework inspired by cognitive science, which schedules sample-rehearsal using the SuperMemo-2 (SM-2) algorithm. SRT maintains per-example review state, maps per-example perplexity to a recall-quality signal, and schedules historical examples for retention and new examples for consolidation while leaving the model, objective, and optimizer unchanged. On temporally separated Wikipedia and code corpora, SRT improves the stability-plasticity trade-off, recovering 5 to 37 percentage points of old-knowledge accuracy lost by naive continual pre-training across model scales while preserving or improving new-knowledge acquisition. At larger scale, SRT preserves broad benchmark performance that naive continual pre-training and uniform replay substantially degrade. Experiments with vision and tabular data further suggest that the scheduling principle extends beyond language when paired with an appropriate recall signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SRT（Spaced Repetition Training），一种基于SuperMemo-2算法的持续预训练样本调度框架。它将每个样本的困惑度映射为回忆质量信号，通过per-example review state决定哪些旧样本应被回放以及哪些新样本应被巩固，在不改变模型架构、损失或优化器的情况下，显著缓解持续预训练中的灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM持续预训练回放方法在混合比例层面进行决策，并对所有样本均匀采样，忽视了不同样本遗忘速度的异质性。均匀回放可能将预算浪费在已稳固记忆的样本上，而忽略易遗忘的关键样本。本文受认知科学中的间隔重复和自适应记忆巩固原理启发，将持续预训练重新定义为自适应调度问题：在给定回放预算下，决定哪些样本应在当前步被复习，而非仅决定旧数据占比。
AI.method: SRT为每个可回放样本维护SuperMemo-2的复习状态，包括ease factor $E_i$、连续成功次数$n_i$、当前间隔$I_i$和下次到期步$d_i$。在训练步$t$，从到期集合$\mathcal{M}_t^{old}$和$\mathcal{M}_t^{new}$中按20/80暴露比采样批次。对每个被复习的样本，在标准前向传播中计算其token级平均困惑度PPL，并通过单调递增阈值将其映射为1-5的回忆质量$q_i$。基于$q_i$按SM-2规则更新ease factor和间隔：低质量样本立即重排，高质量样本按$\lceil I_i E_i\rceil$延长间隔。算法不引入额外损失项或架构改动，调度状态对旧样本（用于保留）和新样本（用于巩固）对称应用。
AI.result: 在TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat和Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct两个规模上，在时间分离的Wikipedia和代码语料上的实验表明：（1）SRT恢复天真CPT损失的5至37个百分点的旧知识准确率，同时保持或提升新知识获取；（2）SRT是唯一在两种规模下同时提升旧/新代码准确率的方法；（3）在3B规模上，Uniform Replay严重破坏推理能力（BBH从53.9%降至8.4%，GSM8K从77.6%降至6.8%），而SRT完整保留了base模型性能（MMLU 57.8%、BBH 52.6%、GSM8K 76.7%、PIQA 74.3%）；（4）在TemporalWiki外部基准上，SRT将CPT造成的近三倍困惑度恶化限制在仅高于base约30%；（5）MNIST/Fashion-MNIST/CIFAR-10/Wine等视觉和表格实验表明该调度原理在替换为分类置信度信号后可推广至非语言模态。计算开销方面，SRT相对CPT增加约14.7%的墙钟时间，其中仅3.5%来自调度特有开销。消融实验验证了20/80暴露比、默认阈值$\alpha=1.0$和初始ease factor $E_0=2.5$为最佳配置。
AI.conclusion: SRT证明了持续预训练不仅是数据混合问题，更是样本调度问题：在保留预算下，模型应优先复习当前正在遗忘的样本，而非已经稳固掌握的样本。其核心贡献在于将调度（而非暴露量本身）确立为回放的关键设计维度，并通过将认知科学中的SuperMemo-2原理移植到语言模型训练实现，无需修改模型架构、损失或优化器即可与现有CPT配方正交组合。关键发现包括：调度而非暴露量是SRT优势来源、均匀回放可能反而损害推理能力、以及调度层是互补而非替代现有方法。该工作同时揭示了灾难性遗忘中样本异质性遗忘难度的重要意义。

title: Quantifying Risk Under Evolving Uncertainty: Belief-Dependent Robustness for Safe Sequential Decision Making
comment: Accepted for presentation at the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 RobustifAI workshop
summary: How cautious should an agent be while it is still learning its environment? We propose RATTL (Risk-Adversarial Total-Reward Learning), which ties caution to epistemic uncertainty: the agent holds a Bayesian posterior over unknown dynamics and plans against a Wasserstein ambiguity set whose radius is a monotone function of that posterior. The radius contracts with evidence, so behaviour interpolates continuously between worst-case robustness and risk-neutral total-reward maximization. The design follows the duality underlying the Entropic Value-at-Risk, which converts the choice of a risk level into the choice of an ambiguity radius. We show the resulting planning problem is well posed under transience and compactness conditions, and prove a Safety Sandwich: the RATTL value lies between the uninformed robust value and the full- knowledge optimum, with a gap that vanishes as the posterior concentrates. In a canonical binary-hazard instance, the induced criterion reduces to Conditional Value-at-Risk at a level set by the posterior entropy. A worked example shows the agent deferring the efficient action until a sharp identification threshold. RATTL targets runtime safety for agents, including LLM-based systems, acting under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 提出RATTL框架，将Wasserstein模糊半径与智能体贝叶斯信念的Shannon熵耦合，使谨慎程度随认知不确定性连续调整，在最坏情况鲁棒性与风险中性之间平滑插值；并证明Bellman算子的收缩性、"安全三明治"价值界、最优响应收敛性，以及在二元灾难场景下诱导的风险度量恰好是CVaR。
AI.motivation: 智能体（尤其是LLM智能体）必须在学习环境的同时采取行动。经典鲁棒控制采用统一最坏情况推理过度保守，贝叶斯RL按信念平均可能不安全。缺乏一种机制能根据智能体的认知状态（信念熵）连续调节其在风险谱（从期望值到CVaR再到ess sup）上的位置：信息匮乏时谨慎，信息充分时转向风险中性优化。
AI.method: （1）将部分可观测轮次博弈规约为具有信念-增广状态空间的主观鲁棒MDP；（2）定义熵调制的Wasserstein模糊集：半径ε(b)=β·H(b)，中心为信念平均核；（3）构建Nash-Robust Bellman算子，内层对模糊集取inf；（4）利用Kantorovich-Rubinstein对偶将内层问题转化为关于信念网格的有限LP；（5）形式化正确性条件（适当性、均匀可达性、可识别性、持续辨识/激励）；（6）以EVaR的KL-DRO对偶作为概念桥梁解释"选择保守度≡选择模糊半径"。
AI.result: 定理1（收缩性）：在适当性和均匀可达性下，加权sup范数下Bellman算子以模ρ=1-1/W收缩，几何收敛；定理2（安全三明治）：V_maximin ≤ V* ≤ Σ_z b(z)V_BR(s,z)，价值始终夹在最坏情况底线与信念平均最优响应顶线之间；定理3（收敛至最优响应）：在持续辨识下b_t→δ_{z*} a.s.，V*(s,b_t)→V_BR(s,z*) a.s.，在持续激励下价格以O(log t/t)收敛；定理4（Wasserstein鲁棒值的相干性）：是相干风险测度并等于Lipschitz正则化期望；命题1（两点Wasserstein风险即CVaR）：在典型二元灾难实例上诱导的尾水平θ(b)=q/(q+βH(b)/D)严格为CVaR；Ambiguous Bridge示例给出闭合形式的安全切换阈值α*=1081/1100≈0.983。
AI.conclusion: RATTL将鲁棒性建模为信念熵的函数，弥合了鲁棒MDP、风险敏感RL与贝叶斯对手建模之间的鸿沟，为运行时不安全（包括LLM智能体在对抗性尾风险下）提供原则性的节制与弃权机制；其"安全三明治"为价值层面提供最坏情况底线与贝叶斯最优响应顶线的可证明括号。明确开放问题包括：|S|≥3时一般transport-CVaR与EVaR比较、Rényi/Tsallis熵作为替代旋钮、信念自适应鲁棒RL的样本复杂度、连续空间的Lipschitz批评扩展。

title: TRUSS: Towards Task-Reliable and User-Safe Automated Agent Skill Generation
summary: Agent Skills package reusable natural language procedures with executable resources, enabling software agents to acquire task specific capabilities without model adaptation. Automatically generating such Skills can improve task performance, yet evaluating a candidate solely from its artifact or final task outcome leaves unresolved which actions the equipped agent will perform and which side effects those actions will produce. We present TRUSS, an evidence guided framework for generating functionally effective and safety reliable Agent Skills. TRUSS first inspects functional claims against source and domain evidence while evaluating the complete artifact under nine predefined safety properties. Candidates admitted by this static gate are loaded by a shadow agent inside a Controllable Execution Environment, where brokered tools expose requested actions to policy enforcement and record their results as provenance preserving execution traces. Functional failures and property violations are linked back to the responsible Skill content and used to guide iterative refinement. We evaluate TRUSS on 168 SkillInject artifacts, 155 SkillSafetyBench cases, and all 187 tasks in SkillGenBench. TRUSS achieves 100.00\% precision and recall in vulnerability detection. Repair reduces attack success from 38.71\% to 19.35\% with GPT 5.5 and from 46.45\% to 29.68\% with GPT 5.4, with zero attack regression. For Skill generation, TRUSS raises task effectiveness from 17.11\% without Skills to 52.94\%, while increasing the benchmark Security rate from 50.80\% to 100.00\%. These results show that execution evidence can expose behavioral failures missed by artifact inspection and can guide Skill generation toward jointly verified functional and safety outcomes.

AI.tldr: TRUSS是一个面向LLM智能体自动化技能(Skill)生成的"静态-动态"联合验证框架。其核心观点是：仅靠对技能产物进行静态检查或最终任务结果评估，无法预判技能被智能体加载执行后产生的具体行为与副作用。TRUSS通过"静态检查→可控执行环境(CSE)动态执行→按九项安全属性审查→链接到违规的Skill内容→迭代修复"的闭环流程，在保障功能有效性的同时确保安全可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体正从虚拟规划走向真实执行，常通过打包可复用的"技能"(自然语言流程+可执行资源)来扩展能力。然而：①现有自动化技能生成主要依赖静态文本分析或最终任务结果，遗漏执行时序下的复合风险(如下载-执行链、跨步骤信息流)；②安全研究已表明第三方技能存在严重漏洞(26.1%含漏洞)，且厂商(OpenAI/Anthropic)已发出安全警告；③功能有效性与安全可靠性存在权衡——更精细的操作流程提升了任务表现却扩大了智能体动作空间，引入不确定行为。这构成了论文的motivation。
AI.method: 1)Generator：从源语料c(可选任务说明t)生成候选技能包(含主指令文档与可执行资源)，冻结并分配内容摘要；2)Checker-静态阶段：基于证据的功能检查(将声明效果与源码/开放世界知识对齐)与九项安全属性静态检查(Control Integrity、Access Boundary、Execution Integrity、Lifecycle Isolation、Resource Boundedness、Evidence Integrity、Authority Integrity、Composition Integrity、Transaction Safety)；3)Static Gate：仅放行通过静态检查且将运行时义务转入受控执行的候选；4)Checker-运行时阶段：在Controllable Execution Environment中由"影子智能体"加载技能，通过broker代理工具暴露请求动作，Intermediate Breaker按属性策略拦截/放行，记录provenance-preserving的执行轨迹；5)Refiner：基于未解决的义务与违规证据，结合已满足的约束进行迭代修复；6)终止条件：所有功能结果与安全义务均被解析则发出"认证技能"，否则输出未认证候选并保留残余证据。支持task-conditioned与task-agnostic两种生成模式。
AI.result: 三个研究问题结果：RQ1(SkillInject,168个artifact,84对)：中间级LLM检查器F1仅26.69%，静态检查器F1提升至87.36%，完整TRUSS达100.00%精确率与召回率(相对静态检查器在精确率上+18.45pp、召回率+5.95pp)；RQ2(SkillSafetyBench,155 cases)：GPT-5.5下ASR从38.71%降至19.35%(消除19.35pp)，GPT-5.4下从46.45%降至29.68%(消除16.77pp)，攻击回归均为0.00%，安全任务完成率分别为52.90%与23.87%；RQ3(SkillGenBench,187 tasks)：无技能基线有效率17.11%，加入LLM生成技能后29.95%(+12.83pp)，完整TRUSS达52.94%(+35.83pp)；安全率从50.80%(无技能)→75.40%(中间生成)→100.00%(TRUSS)。整体表明执行证据可暴露静态检查遗漏的行为失败，并引导技能生成走向功能与安全的联合验证。
AI.conclusion: TRUSS将自动化技能生成重新定位为"功能有效性+安全可靠性"的联合验证问题。静态阶段负责声明-能力一致性预审与可静态确认的属性判定；动态阶段在可控执行环境中以broker代理将每个动作纳入属性策略与执行轨迹；共享的"功能与安全记录"将违规证据链接回具体Skill内容以指导修复，同时保留已通过项作为保留约束。在SkillInject、SkillSafetyBench与SkillGenBench上的综合评测表明：执行证据能有效弥补静态检测盲区，修复过程可在不引入新攻击的前提下显著降低攻击成功率，并在大规模生成任务中同时提升有效性与安全率。论文亦指出局限——残余攻击成功率与目标模型对安全任务完成率的影响表明运行时认证仍受场景覆盖与执行器行为敏感性约束，未来工作将扩展执行场景与属性观察器多样性。

title: MoNe: Modular Neural Memory for Efficient Long Context Inference
summary: We present MoNe, a lightweight modular neural memory that attaches to any frozen pretrained Transformer to enable long-context inference without retraining. MoNe reads context in fixed-size segments via test-time learning of fast-weight neural memory networks with layer-localized gradient updates; at inference, the memory generates keys and values from the query tokens alone, with no context tokens re-read. This two-phase design decouples inference cost from context length, achieving $O(N)$ preprocessing and $O(1)$ query cost with peak GPU memory that does not grow with $N$. At 128K tokens, MoNe reduces both compute and peak GPU memory by approximately 80% compared to ICL with only 6.4% parameter overhead. MoNe generalizes to context lengths far beyond the backbone's native window, achieving strong performance on needle-in-a-haystack and word extraction benchmarks from RULER, where ICL degrades sharply.

AI.tldr: MoNe提出了一种轻量级模块化神经记忆模块，可附加到任何冻结的预训练Transformer上，通过测试时学习实现高效长上下文推理。其核心设计采用固定大小分段读取上下文、分层局部化梯度更新快速权重记忆网络，使预处理复杂度为O(N)、查询复杂度为O(1)，且峰值GPU内存不随上下文长度增长。在128K tokens下，计算量和峰值GPU内存较ICL降低约80%，仅增加6.4%参数开销。
AI.motivation: 长上下文处理对实际AI应用至关重要，但主流的ICL方式存在两个根本问题：(1) 自注意力计算量随上下文长度呈二次方增长(O(N²))，在资源受限设备上成本难以承受；(2) 小模型即使在上下文窗口内也难以可靠提取长距离信息。现有替代方案如RAG受限于局部可恢复事实，无法整合分散信息；循环模型(如Mamba、TTT、Titans)虽实现线性复杂度，但需从头训练新架构，无法直接集成到现有预训练Transformer中。因此需要一个无需重训练即可为冻结预训练Transformer添加长上下文能力的模块化方案。
AI.method: MoNe的核心方法包括三个关键设计：(1) 模块化神经记忆架构——在每个解码器层附加SwiGLU MLP形式的快速权重记忆模块M(·; W⁽ˡ⁾)，使用LoRA低秩适配器适配冻结的W_k、W_v矩阵，仅增加6.4%参数；(2) 两阶段推理范式——测试时学习阶段以T=512固定大小分段顺序处理上下文，通过关联记忆损失ℓ⁽ˡ⁾(W)=-(v⁽ˡ⁾)ᵀ·M(k⁽ˡ⁾;W)（最大化记忆输出与目标值的内积）局部更新各层快速权重，无需跨层反向传播；推理阶段查询仅通过W_q从最终记忆状态W_S⁽ˡ⁾生成固定大小的记忆token，不重新读取上下文token；(3) 段内局部RoPE位置编码——上下文位置pj_local=j mod T∈[0,T)，查询位置在[0,Q)且Q≪T，使位置索引始终在固定范围内，无需位置插值即可泛化到任意长度上下文。最终快权重状态可跨查询复用并支持增量扩展。
AI.result: 实验以Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct为冻结骨干，在RULER基准的S-NIAH、MK-NIAH和Frequent Word Extraction三个任务上，4K-128K tokens范围内评估：(1) 性能方面——MoNe在所有任务和上下文长度上几乎完美(0.96-1.00)，显著优于ICL（128K时S-NIAH降至0.28、MK-NIAH降至0.00）和RAG（受限于分散信息整合）；(2) 效率方面——128K tokens时峰值GPU内存仅1.41GB（ICL为7.07GB，降低80%），总FLOPs为149.61T（ICL为786.33T，降低81%），且峰值GPU内存不随上下文长度增长；(3) 消融研究——全24层覆盖加T=512段大小为最优配置（128K时MK-NIAH达0.94）；减少层数（如最后16层降至0.70）或缩小段大小（T=128降至0.53）会导致长上下文性能显著下降。MoNe仅在≤4K tokens训练即可泛化到128K（32倍外推），无需额外训练或位置插值。
AI.conclusion: MoNe通过模块化神经记忆为冻结预训练Transformer添加了高效的长上下文能力，无需修改骨干参数。其在远超骨干原生窗口的上下文长度上仍保持强性能，大幅优于ICL（ICL超出训练限制后性能急剧下降）并在需要整合分布式信息的任务上超越RAG。该方法以高效率实现这些性能提升——128K tokens时FLOPs和峰值GPU内存均较ICL降低约80%，且内存占用与上下文长度无关，特别适合资源受限的设备端应用（如个性化推荐和持续学习）。当前实验在Qwen2.5-0.5B和RULER受控检索任务上验证，未来工作将扩展到更大模型规模和自然长文档工作负载（如单/多文档QA、真实对话历史），并探索针对每个神经记忆模块的不同LoRA方法以提升效率和灵活性。

title: Validated Adaptation for Aerial Crowd Monitoring at Mass Gathering Scale: A Deployment Protocol, a Severity Law, and a Diagnostic for Label-Free Drone Crowd Counting, Toward the FIFA World Cup 2034 (Saudi Arabia)
summary: Saudi Arabia will host the 2034 FIFA World Cup and already operates crowd management at Hajj scale. Drone-based counting must hold accuracy on footage unlike anything in its training corpus, without labels, and must warn of dangerous inflow before a crush forms. We deliver a validated answer built on 525 controlled runs, a full-resolution corpus study, five falsification ablations, and a five-condition safety-interlock evaluation. Label-free adaptation recovers 31-49% of shift-induced error across four corruptions and five severities, with the strongest method gaining 41.8 MAE over the frozen source (95% CI [34.1, 49.6], p=7.5x10^-10, d=2.52). We establish a severity law separating methods with a constant absolute margin from the one whose margin grows, and a stability budget identifying which configuration is safe to fly. On a full-resolution corpus carrying a genuine +48 MAE aerial gap (source retrained to 14.6 validation MAE, a 34% improvement), adaptation repairs the dense-scene undercounting that would otherwise under-report a forming crush, and the flux-based risk module fires on real congestion episodes in 2 of 6 full-length clips. We localise the recoverable error: in a regime built to favor a physics-informed conservation prior (300-frame clips at 200ms spacing, five times wider than standard), the adaptation signal is normalisation-driven, not flow-driven; the continuity residual is invariant to the proportional counting errors domain shift produces, confirmed by four on/off ablations correlated at r=0.999 and a 40% input corruption moving accuracy by only 0.05 MAE. A label-free shift gate shows shift magnitude and accuracy damage are rank-independent (Spearman rho=0.20; rho=-0.60 among genuine shifts), quantifying the 58% of headroom a magnitude gate forgoes. We establish unconditional adaptation with tail monitoring as policy, closing with a six-point protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文针对2034年沙特FIFA世界杯及Hajj等大规模集会场景，提出了一套基于无标签测试时自适应（TTA）的无人机航拍人群计数验证方案。通过525次受控实验、全分辨率语料库研究、五项可证伪消融实验及五条件安全联锁评估，得出三项核心结论：(1) 无标签自适应可在外观偏移下恢复30-49%的误差，且保护性差距不随严重程度恶化反而扩大；(2) 基于光流的连续性残差对比例性计数误差具备不变性，因此基于物理守恒先验的自适应无法提供增益——可恢复的误差集中在归一化统计量上；(3) 基于BN统计量的偏移幅度门控与真实精度损害无关（Spearman ρ=0.20），最优策略是无条件自适应配合尾部监控，可捕获100%可用余量，而幅度门控仅捕获42%。最终给出面向集成商的六点部署协议及校准活动框架。
AI.motivation: 大规模集会（2034沙特世界杯、Hajj）人群密度在事故发生前数分钟已累积，但人工监控难以实时识别。无人机航拍计数模型在跨场景、跨光照、跨压缩传输时会因外观偏移（altitude/illumination/optics/encoding）而失效，且事件现场无任何真值标签可用。因此必须在无监督条件下完成测试时自适应。直觉上提出：相邻帧间人数守恒，若密度预测与光流测量不一致即为可纠错的标签无关信号——同一物理定律可同时充当自适应信号与安全预警信号。本文即验证这一假设在安全部署所需严苛条件下是否成立。
AI.method:
方法体系包含三轨实验设计：
- **骨干与自适应族**：CSRNet密度回归器，严格遵循TENT协议——冻结全部卷积权重，仅更新BN层参数；比较Source（冻结）、AdaBN（仅BN统计重对齐）、TENT（熵最小化）、Ours（仅守恒残差）、TENT+Ours（两者联合）五种配置。
- **物理守恒先验**：基于RAFT光流估计位移场vt，在像素网格上离散化连续性方程，导出连续性残差rt = D(t+1) − D(t) + ∇·(Dt·vt)，最小化‖rt‖²₂。可单独使用或与熵目标加权联合。
- **通量风险指示器**：区域边界积分Φt = −∮(Dt·vt·n)dℓ，作为相对拥塞起始指标；绝对阈值需米/像素地面比例标定。
- **偏移门控安全联锁**：比较入流BN统计量与清洁缓存的差异得标量偏移分数s，仅当s > τ（τ=2·s_clean）时启动自适应。
- **三轨实验**：Track A（n=750受控偏移，四类合成腐败×五级严重度×五种子=525次运行）、Track B（11GB全分辨率语料，200ms帧间隔×300帧片段，全重训源模型val MAE 22.3→14.6，含+48 MAE真实航拍域差）、Track C（五条件下门控策略评估）。
- **统计纪律**：配对t检验+95%CI+配对Cohen's dz+Wilcoxon符号秩+Holm–Bonferroni族校正；稳定性以跨复现CV与最差运行报告。
AI.result:
**结果1（自适应效能与严重度律）**：参考严重度下Source达96.1 MAE，所有自适应方法落入52-58区间，相对Source恢复40-46%偏移误差；最强方法AdaBN聚合20次复现获得41.8 MAE增益（95% CI [34.1, 49.6]，p=7.5×10⁻¹⁰，d=2.52）。严重度扫描揭示"严重度律"——熵单目标保持近似恒定绝对保护差距（35.7→35.3 MAE），而TENT+Ours扩大其绝对差距（30.4→45.8 MAE），自严重度2起反超TENT。稳定性预算显示TENT+Ours最差运行发生于最低严重度（113.5 MAE, motion blur sev.1），源于目标叠加放大既有低偏移不稳定。

**结果2（全语料迁移）**：在含+48 MAE真实航拍域差的Track B上，源模型对密集场景系统性低估（dense band MAE 194.7，bias −194.7），自适应后密集场景MAE降至98.5，bias −98.4，sparse场景MAE从70.3降至9.4——直接修正与安全案例相关的形成中挤压场景的误差。通量模块在6个全长片段中2次触发真实拥塞事件，首例召回率1.00、平均提前4.4s预警。

**结果3（信号定位）**：四项开关消融显示守恒项在Track A（Δ=+0.13/+0.18）、Track B清洁（Δ=+0.28, 95% CI [−0.28, 0.84], p=0.24）与低光（Δ=−0.05）下均无效；ON/OFF配对MAE相关系数r=0.9994。输入腐败消融中向光流注入40%噪声仅移动MAE 0.05（43.86→43.91）。机制解释：连续性残差对域偏移产生的近似比例性计数误差具备构造性不变性——Dt+1−Dt与∇·(Dt·vt)同尺度缩放，残差近似为零。

**结果4（部署策略）**：偏移门控在极端情况正确（清洁不触发、低光触发恢复43%误差），但在motion blur与JPEG上失败——二者统计位移极小（s=0.00207/0.00135均低于τ=0.0022）却造成93.4/87.5 MAE Source误差（55%/49%可恢复）。整体Spearman ρ=0.20（p=0.75），真实偏移间ρ=−0.60。幅度门控仅捕获42%可用余量，无条件自适应捕获100%，故导出策略为无条件自适应+尾部监控。

**结果5（消融诊断价值）**：输入腐败消融被推荐为辅助目标的两运行首线诊断——若某项梯度有信息，其输入退化必须退化输出。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了无标签TTA在大规模集会航拍人群监测中部署的条件：(1) 自适应为派生最优策略，应无条件运行；(2) 推荐单目标配置——BN统计重对齐+熵最小化，因联合目标虽均值更优但尾部不稳定；(3) 自适应容量应配置于归一化与预测置信度，不应投放于光流守恒——后者在外观偏移下对所需误差具备不变性，仅在遮挡、出入口净流等破坏计数平衡的偏移下才携带梯度；(4) 必须执行尾部预算（CV≤~12%，最差运行相对中位数有界）；(5) 通量报警应以排序模式作为操作员辅助，绝对自动触发需待米/像素标定活动后启用；(6) 部署前需完成标定活动（地面比例、拥塞出入口片段、偏移描述子到误差的标定扫描），以解锁绝对挤压阈值、经校验的提前时间曲线及基于损害而非统计距离的联锁。本文贡献的可转移部分——配对种子协议、两项可证伪消融、策略级安全门评估——可直接复用至WC-2034与Hajj现场影像。

title: Graph Surgery and the Do-Operator: A Precise Correspondence for Acyclic Structural Causal Models
summary: The $\operatorname{do}$-operator is described graphically by deleting arrows into its targets and functionally by replacing their mechanisms with constants. To call these operations equivalent is not yet a mathematical statement: one returns a graph and remembers only the targets, whereas the other returns mechanisms and also remembers the imposed values. We make a dependency-level comparison precise for deterministic acyclic structural causal models with finitely many endogenous variables. If $\operatorname{Graph}(F)$ extracts the dependencies of a mechanism family $F$, our main theorem is $\operatorname{Graph}(F^\iota)=\operatorname{Surg}(\operatorname{Graph}(F),T_\iota)$. Thus replacing target mechanisms removes exactly the dependencies removed by graph surgery. For a model $M=(G,F)$ whose graph may contain unused arrows, we characterize when the same equality holds with $G$ in place of $\operatorname{Graph}(F)$; it holds for every intervention exactly when $G$ records the dependencies of $F$ exactly. We then define the intervened model, characterize its run, show how sequential interventions combine, and prove that an outcome depends only on interventions at its actual dependency ancestors.

AI.tldr: 本文针对确定性有限无环结构因果模型，证明了图手术（删除目标节点的入边）与 do-算子（用常数替换目标机制）在依赖图层面的精确等价性：Graph(F^ι) = Surg(Graph(F), T_ι)，并刻画了该等式与模型附带图一致的条件，以及顺序干预组合律与祖先依赖定理。
AI.motivation: Pearl 的 do-算子有两种直观描述：图层面删除目标节点的入边，函数层面用常数替换目标机制。Zhang 曾猜想二者等价，但该断言并非严格数学命题——二者作用于不同对象，且图手术不区分 do(A=0) 与 do(A=1)。此外，模型附带的图 G 可能包含未被机制实际使用的"多余箭头"，这使得图手术与机制替换的对应关系需进一步刻画。本文旨在将这些直觉在依赖图层面精确化，并明确附带图与机制依赖图的关系。
AI.method: 基于"机制对变量的依赖"严格定义依赖图 Graph(F)（Definition 1），引入因果模型的"兼容"（Graph(F) ⊆ G）与"精确"（Graph(F) = G）之分；通过按目标与非目标变量的逐情形分析证明主定理（Theorem 3.1）；借助相容性与等式条件刻画附带图上手术何时与机制替换一致（Corollary 1）；通过图与机制族的双重对照证明顺序干预的合并律（Theorem 4.1）；最后沿依赖图的拓扑序归纳证明祖先定理（Theorem 5.1），并给出若干推论与反例。
AI.result: （1）主定理 Graph(F^ι) = Surg(Graph(F), T_ι)，即替换目标机制与提取依赖后手术得到相同的依赖图；（2）Corollary 1 刻画：Graph(F^ι) = Surg(G, T_ι) 当且仅当 G 中不属于 Graph(F) 的多余箭头全部进入干预目标；对所有干预成立当且仅当模型精确；（3）Corollary 2 说明 Do(M,ι) 与 (Graph(F^ι), F^ι) 同 run，精确模型下二者相等；（4）Theorem 4.1 给出顺序干预合并律，后施加的值覆盖前者（Corollary 4 的四条基本定律）；（5）Theorem 5.1（祖先定理）：结局集 O 的取值仅依赖于干预在 An_F(O) 上的部分，An_F(O) 之外的目标可被丢弃（Corollary 5）；同时给出 XOR 反例表明祖先条件充分而非必要。
AI.conclusion: 本文在依赖图层面将 do-算子的图手术描述与机制替换描述严格等价化，明晰了"附带图"与"机制依赖图"的区别与一致性条件，给出了顺序干预的代数律与结局对祖先依赖的定理。这些结果为 Zhang 关于 do-算子两种视图等价性的猜想提供了适于机械化（如 Coq）证明的依赖级表述，并在保持结构与功能组件分离的同时完整刻画了干预语义。

title: Beyond the Trace: Coupling an Interpretable Reasoning-State Readout to Native MoE Routing
summary: What a reasoning model writes is only a partial record of the process that produces it. We introduce a two-level internal readout for mixture-of-experts reasoning. We first distill vocabulary-scale J-space into J64, a 64-axis semantic frame learned from the model's own reasoning states. J64 reveals readable process state that the emitted trace does not show: it separates inference effort from problem-induced strain. It also adds 0.096 to 0.135 held-out AUC over a baseline that reads the same rollout as token occupancy and aggregates it in exactly the same way. We then reconstruct J64 from native expert-routing statistics. The result is R64, a low-overhead proxy: its median per-axis correlation with J64 is 0.69 to 0.86 across three models and two families, and on gpt-oss-20b it preserves 95 to 100% of J64's predictive gain. The readout supports test-time decisions at two temporal resolutions. Over completed candidate sets, J64 and R64 improve single-branch selection, and R64-weighted voting improves plain majority voting in seven of eight settings. During generation, rolling readout windows drive a cumulative stop-and-resample policy whose operating point is fixed on training questions alone. J64 improves accuracy by 1.1 to 5.9 points over a sibling-permuted control, and the routing-only R64 proxy retains 0.9 to 3.2 of those points. Finally, router edits aimed at the mechanism J64 names induce the predicted reasoning behaviors and shift a diagnosed stall from numerical guessing toward exact symbolic execution. Together, J64 makes latent process state readable, while routing makes it deployable and actionable.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 J64（一个 64 维可解释语义坐标系，从模型的推理隐藏状态中蒸馏得到）和 R64（从 MoE 原生路由统计中重构 J64 的低开销代理），将推理模型的潜在过程状态从不可读的"内部过程"转变为可在测试时部署和干预的可操作信号。J64 揭示了推理文本中未显式呈现的过程状态，R64 则使其能在不重放激活的情况下从路由信息中恢复，并支持分支选择、投票加权、在线停止重采样以及路由编辑等测试时决策。
AI.motivation: 推理模型输出的文本仅记录模型选择"写出"的内容，而非产生该内容的完整过程状态。文本不直接揭示哪些约束和备选方案仍然活跃、较长推导反映的是配置的工作量还是真实难度，或者当前分支是否正在失效。对于测试时的分支选择和计算分配而言，这些区分比最终答案更早出现，因此需要一种能读取模型内部过程状态（而非仅文本）的信号，并将其以低开销方式部署到 MoE 推理系统中。
AI.method: 1. J64 语义坐标系：在模型自身的隐藏状态上利用 Jacobian lens 投射到词汇方向，通过稀疏编码质量或 lens 解码频率两种无需标签的种子统计聚类为 64 个语义轴，使用伪逆（非正交）读取每个状态；轴名在构造完成后命名，不影响读取。2. R64 路由代理：从三个 MoE 层的专家使用谱（gate 权重归一化与每层门控熵）通过岭回归映射到 64 维 J64 轴，无需结果标签；拟合一次后冻结，部署时仅读取路由。3. 测试时决策：（a）已完成分支选择与投票加权；（b）滚动窗口下的 CUSUM 控制器实现累积停止重采样策略；（c）针对 J64 命名机制的路由 logit 编辑进行因果干预。统计单位为问题，采用问题级聚类 bootstrap 置信区间，所有拟合组件均在一个基准上训练后冻结并迁移至其他基准。
AI.result: 在三个模型（gpt-oss-20b、gpt-oss-120b、Qwen3-30B-A3B Thinking/Instruct）与两种家族、八个模型-工作强度设置上：RQ1 中 J64 较匹配的 3000 维 token 占用基线在三种工作强度下分别提升持出 AUC +0.135/+0.129/+0.096，区分"推理姿态"（与工作强度相关）和"问题诱发张力"（与难度相关）两个可读坐标；RQ2 中 R64 各轴中位数相关系数达 0.69–0.86，在 gpt-oss-20b 上保留 J64 预测增益的 95%–100%，且单 token 路由仍可达 r=0.42–0.48；RQ3 中 J64/R64 加权投票在 8 个设置中的 7 个优于多数投票，单分支选择在多数模型组优于随机挑选，并能在多数投票失败的 223 个"救援"问题上将命中率从 8.7% 提升至 J64 17.0%、R64 14.1%；RQ4 中 J64 在停止重采样任务上较兄弟排列控制提升 +1.1 至 +5.9 个百分点，R64 保留其中 +0.9 至 +3.2 个百分点；RQ5 中针对 J64 命名的案例分裂束与"探查而非执行"机制的路由编辑分别诱发预期的行为变化（"Case n" 枚举长度达 100 个表头，将猜数值转为精确符号推导）。
AI.conclusion: J64 将推理痕迹中隐含的过程状态转化为可读的 64 维仪表板，R64 从原生 MoE 路由（无需激活重放）中重构该状态，使其可在服务时部署；两者共同支撑分支选择、投票加权和在线停止重采样等测试时策略，而针对命名机制的路由编辑进一步验证了 J64 语义的因果性。"J64 提供语义，路由提供部署，测试时策略使信号可执行"是本文的核心贡献框架；该工作的局限在于分析集中于竞赛数学与 gpt-oss 系列、模型帧彼此不对齐、序列感知文本基线与实际服务场景留待未来工作。

title: LLM-Derived Preference Judgments Are Not Self-Consistent
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures; includes appendices
summary: Agents increasingly interpret a person's natural-language preferences by querying an LLM for numerical preference judgments, e.g., by asking how much the person would be willing to pay for an item. A growing body of work estimates a utility function from these judgments and then chooses actions based on their estimated utility. This pipeline assumes the judgments are approximately self-consistent: that a single utility function can reproduce them. But are they? To study this question, we measure the self-consistency of cardinal LLM preference judgments. For example, the difference in stated willingness-to-pay between two items should match the stated payment that makes a person indifferent to exchanging them. We develop statistical tests and interpretable measures of how far observed responses depart from the best-fitting self-consistent utility function. Experiments with flight, apartment, and hotel examples across six LLMs reveal large persistent inconsistencies. This suggests that LLM-derived preference judgments cannot be faithfully summarized by a single utility function.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM在数值化偏好判断（如"用户愿意为某物品支付多少钱"）中的自洽性问题。作者提出自我一致性假设（H_SC）：来自同一效用函数的不同查询方式（item query和offer-pair query）的回答均值应当一致。通过设计flight、apartment、hotel三个领域的实验，在六种LLM上测试，发现LLM的偏好判断存在显著且持续的不一致性，无法用单一效用函数忠实概括。特别是item查询和offer-pair查询之间的差异最大，且在2.1%-12.5%的比较中会导致偏好反转。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地被用作从自然语言偏好中提取数值偏好判断的工具，下游决策系统通常假设这些判断可以被一个稳定的效用函数忠实概括。但这一核心假设——即LLM对同一偏好以不同方式提问时应给出一致答案——从未被系统检验。如果该假设不成立，则基于LLM偏好判断的整个决策管道（估计效用函数→选择行动）的理论基础将受到质疑。
AI.method: 核心方法是一种"自洽性审计协议"，仅依赖准线性效用（quasi-linear utility）假设，对每个物品赋予无限制的美元价值。(1) 全局检验：对每个审计组（模型×领域×话语）拟合最佳共享效用函数U_hat，计算剩余RMSE T，用查询内非参数bootstrap（B=2000）检验H_SC是否成立。(3) 局部检验P1：比较直接offer-pair估计与沿路径的offer-pair估计之和（路径和应等于直接估计）。(2) 局部检验P2：比较offer-pair估计与价格调整后的item查询差异（两者应估计同一效用差）。设计：3个领域×3种话语×9组审计，使用300个查询×15次完成=4500次调用/模型，6个模型（Claude Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.5 Flash、GPT-5.5、GPT-OSS 120B、Llama 3.3 70B、Qwen 3.6 27B），Bonferroni校正（α=0.05/9=0.0056）。
AI.result: 所有六个模型在Bonferroni校正后均拒绝了"九个审计组全部自洽"的联合假设，五个模型拒绝了全部九个组，Qwen拒绝了四个组。平均RMSE范围：航班和公寓为1.6%-6.1%，酒店高达18.9%-44.9%。P2检验（item查询vs offer-pair查询）失败最严重：41.7%-87.5%的P2残差置信区间排除零，2.1%-12.5%的比较出现"支持的反转"（即两种查询方式推荐的物品相反）。P1检验（路径和vs直接估计）失败程度较低，6.2%-68.8%拒绝率，且随路径步数k增加，P1误差普遍增大（k=16时误差高于k=2）。
AI.conclusion: LLM衍生的数值偏好判断不能被单一美元价值效用函数忠实概括。查询方式的选择会显著影响估计结果，并可能导致决策反转。这表明在使用LLM进行偏好学习时需要谨慎：(1) 应在应用前用本审计协议检测一致性；(2) 应选择自洽性更好的LLM；(3) 应尽可能用真实人类判断佐证LLM的偏好判断。本文是测量内部一致性的审计而非人类忠实度评估——LLM仍可能一致但与真实偏好不符，未来工作需要人类被试来校准这些不一致性。

title: GraphWake: Group Polarization via Memory-Mediated Polarization Cascade in LLM-Agent Communities
summary: LLM-driven agents can autonomously exchange opinions on online platforms and form communities. Such agent-operated social platforms raise a new security concern: attackers may manipulate agents to induce group polarization. Existing methods manipulate agent prompts or construct echo chambers, both of which are difficult to realize in practice. We therefore formulate a new threat, Memory-Mediated Polarization Cascade, which uses agent memory as a persistence channel and public discussion as a propagation channel. This threat contains three stages. During exposure and memory retention, the attacker exposes a small set of target agents to arguments that reinforce their respective stated stances. The targets' memory systems then process and retain these arguments. During retrieval and reproduction, a shared stance-neutral discussion cues the targets to retrieve and reproduce their respective retained arguments. During iterative propagation, untreated agents influenced by the reproduced arguments restate and spread them. We instantiate this threat in GraphWake with three components: (i) stance-support argumentation knowledge graphs construct knowledge-based arguments; (ii) axiom-oriented triple selection distills them for reliable retention and reproduction; and (iii) stance-neutral memory cueing triggers concurrent retrieval and reproduction, initiating propagation. Experiments across multiple discussions and memory systems show that GraphWake substantially increases group polarization. These findings reveal a community-level polarization risk.

AI.tldr: GraphWake 提出了一种针对 LLM 智能体社区的新型红队攻击——"记忆介导的极化级联"（Memory-Mediated Polarization Cascade）。仅需攻击 10% 的智能体，通过知识图谱构建立场支持论证、公理化三元组精简、以及立场中立的记忆提示触发，就能在多种记忆系统（LangMem、Mem0、A-Mem）和骨干模型下显著提升社区群体极化程度（均值 P 从 0.098 升至 0.146，ER 从 0.130 升至 0.213）。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体正大量涌入在线平台（如 MoltBook 已拥有 10 万+智能体和百万级帖子），形成具有涌现集体行为的社区，带来新的安全风险：攻击者可能操纵智能体放大群体极化。现有方法要么修改智能体提示（需开发者权限），要么构建回音室（平台通常反其道而行），均难以实际部署。因此需要一种无需系统提示访问、无需构造回音室的新型威胁模型，在大规模上线前进行社区级红队评估。
AI.method: 提出三阶段威胁模型：(1) 暴露与记忆保留——向少量目标智能体注入与其立场一致的论证；(2) 检索与再现——通过共享的立场中立讨论触发目标智能体调取并复述保留内容；(3) 迭代传播——未处理智能体受复述内容影响后进一步扩散。GraphWake 包含三个核心组件：(i) 立场支持论证知识图谱——从多角度构建基于知识的立场支持论证，并经端点压缩和跨组件桥接优化；(ii) 公理导向三元组选择——基于归一化有向介数中心性提取中心路径，再用 LLM 蒸馏为紧凑自然语言公理以提高记忆保留率；(iii) 立场中立记忆提示——计算跨立场实体的余弦相似度，选取 Top-K 高分实体构造共享提示帖，从而同时激活不同立场目标的差异化记忆。
AI.result: 在 MoltBook 真实交互数据重建的 Reddit 类仿真平台上，基于 8 个命题（C1-C4、E1-E4）、3 种记忆系统、2 种骨干模型（Qwen3.5-Flash、DeepSeek-V4-Flash）的实验表明：(1) 仅攻击 10% 智能体即可在 48 个案例中的 44 个中提升 ER 和 P 极化指标；(2) 优化公理使 LPR 从 0.382 提升至 0.847，显著改善记忆中的字面载荷保留；(3) 阻断级联传播后极化回到基线水平，证明社区级极化主要源于向未处理智能体的传播溢出；(4) 暴露窗口大小比目标比例对极化的影响更一致；(6) 消融实验中记忆提示贡献最大；(7) 防御评估显示困惑度过滤几乎无效（ΔP 仅 -0.012），而改写防御有中等抑制效果（ΔP 约 -0.1）。
AI.conclusion: GraphWake 揭示了 LLM 智能体社区中一个被忽视的、仅依赖记忆持久性和公开讨论作为传播通道的级联式极化风险。该攻击在主流记忆系统下普遍有效，且无需系统提示访问，具有较强的现实威胁性。研究强调了在智能体大规模部署前进行社区级安全评估的必要性，并呼吁针对记忆来源（memory provenance）和跨智能体检索内容传播开发防御机制。论文明确表示仅作为受控红队研究，未在真实系统上执行攻击。

title: Auditing Self-Evolution in Financial Agents: Capability Gains, Security Drift, and Execution-Interface Mismatch
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures
summary: Self-evolving agents turn experience into reusable skills, workflows, or memories, but post-evolution accuracy alone does not show whether learned behavior preserves previously correct behavior or security. We audit SkillOpt, Agent Workflow Memory (AWM), and ReasoningBank in simulated e-banking using matched benign acquisition trajectories, sealed evaluation endpoints, execution-grounded checks, and independent state replay. On Qwen 3.7 Flash, SkillOpt raises benign utility from 0.741 to 0.837 while exposure to injected content rises from 0.820 to 0.943. Conditional attack success after exposure falls from 0.605 to 0.562, yet overall attack success rate (ASR) rises from 0.496 to 0.530 and unauthorized financial state changes rise to 0.685. Across three independently evolved lineages, capability, exposure, and unauthorized-state changes increase in all three, whereas ASR increases in only two. ReasoningBank raises utility to 0.859 without increasing aggregate ASR, although unauthorized state changes remain slightly above Static. AWM reveals a separate evaluation hazard: a literal WebArena text-action envelope disrupts tool execution in our native function-calling executor. In a post-hoc sensitivity test, removing only that envelope restores utility from 0.319 to 0.756, while exposure rises from 0.299 to 0.909 and ASR from 0.195 to 0.575. Auditing self-evolving financial agents therefore requires tracking regressions, attack-surface contact, unauthorized financial-state change, and artifact-executor compatibility, not accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了三种自演化智能体系统（SkillOpt、AWM、ReasoningBank）在模拟电子银行场景中的能力提升与安全漂移问题。研究发现：能力提升与安全风险可发生解耦——SkillOpt将良性效用从0.741提升至0.837的同时，攻击暴露面增加了12.3个百分点，未授权金融状态变更增加了10.2个百分点；ReasoningBank提升了更多效用却不增加总体攻击成功率；AWM则因执行接口不匹配（WebArena文本动作信封与原生函数调用不兼容）而出现能力崩溃假象。文章主张仅以演化后准确率评估自演化金融智能体是不充分的，必须同时追踪回归、攻击面接触、未授权金融状态变更以及工件与执行器的兼容性。
AI.motivation: 自演化智能体将经验转化为可复用技能、工作流或记忆，但演化后准确率单一指标无法揭示学习行为是否保留了原本正确的行为或安全性。金融智能体中，学习指令可能同时增加有用信息和攻击者控制指令的接触面——两者通过同一交互表面到达。因此需要一种执行落地的（execution-grounded）审计协议，分解能力增益、攻击暴露、条件顺从性与实际金融状态危害，以填补"misevolution"风险表征在受控金融审计方面的空白。
AI.method: 在AgentDojo Banking v1.2.2基础上进行预模型审计，修复了4个有缺陷的官方效用断言，形成修正后的15族套件；采用六种意图保持变体（v0-v5），其中v0/v1用于采集，v2用于SkillOpt验证，v3/v4/v5作为密封评估端点；运行三条独立演化谱系，每条谱系内三个系统共享字节相同的良性采集轨迹（22条）；主执行器为qwen3.7-flash-2026-07-15（temperature=0.0，禁用思考）；攻击采用AgentDojo的important_instructions，无防御；指标包括良性效用、W→C/C→W配对转换、暴露率、条件ASR、总体ASR以及基于状态重放的未授权金融状态变更（含转账、收款人替换、金额篡改、支付修改、账户/密码变更五类）；并以方法匹配的通用状态安慰剂作为次级对照。
AI.result: SkillOpt在全部三条独立演化谱系中均提升了良性效用（+11.1/+15.6/+2.2 pp），扩大了攻击暴露（+4.4/+19.3/+13.3 pp），并增加了未授权金融状态变更（+0.7/+12.2/+17.8 pp），但总体ASR仅在2/3谱系中上升（-7.4/+7.3/+10.4 pp），条件ASR反而下降；ReasoningBank效用提升+8.9/+11.1/+15.6 pp（3/3），总体ASR均下降（3/3），但未授权状态变更仍略高于Static；AWM原始端口因<think>/动作信封与原生函数调用执行器不兼容而崩溃（效用0.319，71个C→W回归），仅移除标签字符串（保留所有非标签内容）即可将效用恢复至0.756，同时暴露从0.299飙升至0.909，揭示"能力失败+安全改善"双重假象实为执行接口失配；目标键控ASR在每种条件下都低估了未授权状态变更的危害（如SkillOpt的+29.2%相对低估），凸显必须基于金融终态独立审计。
AI.conclusion: 良性自演化并不保证安全改进。本审计证明能力提升可与攻击面扩张和实际金融危害并行发生，且效应具有方法依赖性。攻击成功率（ASR）是各安全指标中跨谱系方向一致性最差的；审计应聚焦于回归、攻击面接触、未授权金融状态变更以及工件-执行器兼容性，而非仅凭端点准确率。建议将自演化智能体评估为"学习规则→演化工件→执行器行为→交互表面→金融状态"的闭环，单独报告暴露与执行落地危害。金融智能体的演化部署必须执行端到端审计。

title: Mixture-of-Expert Blocks Contain Strong Hallucination Detection Signals
summary: Despite their widespread use, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain limited by a fundamental problem: the generation of plausible but false content, known as hallucinations. Most existing detection methods operate at the answer or sentence level, yet per-token detection is essential for localizing hallucinated spans and enabling fine-grained interventions. In this paper, we explore the use of the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm to address this gap. In MoE architectures, a single forward pass activates a sparse subset of experts (i.e., distinct feedforward networks per layer) via a routing mechanism, producing internal signals (e.g., router entropy, expert disagreement, and expert usage patterns) that are unavailable in dense architectures and have not been previously exploited for hallucination detection. To this end, we introduce InnerExpert, the first method to leverage these MoE-specific signals for per-token hallucination detection. InnerExpert combines routing-level and standard transformer signals into compact per-token feature vectors, classified by a lightweight detector trained on labels produced by an LLM-as-a-judge pipeline, which enables continuous model updates without manual annotation. Our results show that InnerExpert outperforms existing methods across five datasets and two MoE architectures, achieving up to 0.91 answer-level and 0.76 token-level AUROC, while requiring only a single forward pass.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InnerExpert，首个利用MoE架构特有的路由信号（如router entropy、专家分歧、专家使用模式）进行逐token幻觉检测的方法，通过结合路由级与标准Transformer信号构建轻量级分类器，在五个数据集和两种MoE架构上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）普遍存在的"幻觉"问题（即生成看似合理但实际错误的内容）仍是其核心缺陷。现有的幻觉检测方法大多在答案或句子级别进行，而要在生成过程中定位幻觉片段并实施细粒度干预，则需要逐token级别的检测能力。Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）架构在单次前向传播中通过路由机制激活稀疏的专家子集（每个层不同的前馈网络），由此产生的内部信号（如路由熵、专家分歧、专家使用模式）在密集架构中并不存在，但尚未被研究用于幻觉检测。
AI.method: 本文提出InnerExpert，一种全新的逐token幻觉检测方法。其核心思路是：(1) 从MoE架构中提取特有的路由级信号（包括router entropy、专家分歧、专家使用模式等），并将其与标准Transformer信号结合；(2) 构建紧凑的逐token特征向量；(3) 使用由LLM-as-a-judge流水线生成的标签训练一个轻量级分类器，从而支持无需人工标注的持续模型更新。整个检测流程仅需单次前向传播。
AI.result: InnerExpert在五个数据集和两种MoE架构上的实验表明，其性能优于现有方法，在答案级别AUROC达到最高0.91，在token级别AUROC达到最高0.76，且仅需单次前向传播即可完成检测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次证明MoE架构特有的路由信号能够有效用于逐token级别的幻觉检测，填补了细粒度幻觉检测研究的空白。InnerExpert作为首个利用MoE内部信号的方法，在检测精度和计算效率方面均具有显著优势，为在生成过程中实施细粒度幻觉干预提供了可行路径。

title: Accuracy and Robustness of Model Cascades Under Data Perturbations
summary: Prediction cascades significantly reduce energy consumption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) models while maintaining high predictive performance. The idea is that easy inputs are routed through a lightweight small model, and difficult uncertain cases are deferred to a larger model. While this design can improve computational efficiency on clean data, its effectiveness depends on the reliability of confidence-based routing. Input degradations, such as static corruptions and sequential perturbations, can shift model confidence and routing decisions. In this paper, we study confidence-based cascade frameworks for image classification and investigate how such degradations affect their confidence-based deferral behavior. We select a model cascade at the pareto-optimum of accuracy, routing quality, and energy consumption that achieves competitive predictive performance with an up to 10-fold decrease in CO$_2$ emissions. We study the behavior of that model cascade under input corruptions and analyze how the cascade's routing decisions change when the input distribution shifts. Our analysis identifies three failure modes. Static corruptions either (1) break the routing signal while the large model remains useful, or (2) degrade both models so deferral no longer recovers accuracy. Sequential perturbations reveal a third mode: predictions stabilize but deferral suppresses, yielding stable but unreliable predictions. These findings demonstrate that energy efficient model cascades require evaluation beyond clean accuracy, with explicit attention to routing reliability under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 本文研究输入退化（静态损坏与序列扰动）对基于置信度路由的模型级联（Model Cascade）系统可靠性的影响。作者基于 Gatekeeper 框架，在 CIFAR-10/100 上构建以 SmallCNN 为轻量模型、ResNet-18 为大模型的级联系统，并在 CIFAR-10-C/100-C 与 CIFAR-10-P/100-P 上进行鲁棒性评估。论文识别出三种级联失效模式：（1）路由信号失效但大模型仍可用；（2）两个模型同时退化导致延迟推理无法恢复精度；（3）序列扰动下预测趋于稳定但延迟决策被抑制，产生"稳定但不可靠"的预测。
AI.motivation: 预测级联通过将简单样本路由到轻量模型、困难样本延迟到大型模型，能显著降低推理能耗（本文场景中 CO₂ 排放最高可减少 10 倍）。然而该效率收益完全依赖于置信度路由的可靠性。现实部署中输入常受压缩伪影、噪声、天气退化等影响，会改变模型置信度与路由决策。此前研究多聚焦干净数据下的效率或单模型鲁棒性，鲜有工作系统分析级联路由与输入退化之间的交互作用。核心问题在于：输入退化达到何种程度时级联的效率优势会消失？哪些退化类型对路由可靠性威胁最大？
AI.method: 采用 Gatekeeper 置信度延迟框架：小型模型 M_S（自定义 SmallCNN）首先进行预测，当最大 softmax 置信度超过阈值 τ=0.7 时接受，否则延迟到大型模型 M_L（ResNet-18）。M_S 使用 correctness-aware 损失 ℒ_GK = αℒ_corr + (1-α)ℒ_incorr 进行微调，α∈{0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9}。在 Pareto 最优（α=0.9）下选定级联配置。在 CIFAR-10-C/100-C（19 类静态损坏，5 个强度等级，分 Noise/Blur/Weather/Digital 四组）和 CIFAR-10-P/100-P（6 类 30 帧序列扰动）上评估。指标包括级联准确率（CascAcc）、延迟性能（s_d，归一化曲线下面积比）、级联翻转率（mFP-Casc）、以及用 codecarbon 估算的 CO₂ 排放。
AI.result: （1）干净数据：CIFAR-10 上级联准确率 0.922 vs M_L 0.941，能耗降低约 40%；CIFAR-100 上级联 0.744 vs M_L 0.771，CO₂ 排放降低约 10 倍。（2）静态损坏下损坏严重度排序一致为 Noise >> Blur > Weather ≈ Digital。CIFAR-10-C 主要呈现路由失效：M_L 在损坏下仍保持高准确率（如 Noise-1 时 0.84 vs M_S 0.67，27 个百分点差距），但置信度信号被破坏（s_d 由 0.686 降至约 0.35），级联损失约 19 pp 可恢复精度。CIFAR-100-C 则呈现双模型退化：严重 Noise 下 M_L 与 M_S 准确率均降至 0.10 以下，大模型作为后备失效，问题根源在于任务复杂度而非路由。（3）序列扰动下准确率下降较缓（CIFAR-10-P 降至 0.80–0.85），且翻转率降低看似稳定性提升，但实际延迟率从 0.505 降至 0.34–0.39（CIFAR-10-P），级联更多依赖退化的 M_S，造成"稳定但不可靠"的失效。
AI.conclusion: 能量高效的模型级联需要在干净准确率之外进行评估，并显式关注分布偏移下的路由可靠性。失效模式取决于任务复杂度：低标签基数（CIFAR-10）保留大模型鲁棒性，暴露路由脆弱性；高标签基数（CIFAR-100）使两个模型同时崩溃，揭示根本的模型脆性。未来方向包括：（1）偏移感知的 Gatekeeper 机制，在退化输入下自适应调整推理阈值；（2）在路由决策中引入不确定性校准或损坏感知的置信度校正，避免退化样本被 M_S 错误接受；（3）将分析扩展到更大规模数据集、更多模型家族及真实部署场景下的延迟、能耗与 CO₂ 测量。

title: Beyond Suspicious Steps: Ontological Trust in Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents increasingly operate across many steps, tools, and observa- tions. In this setting, the relevant oversight question is not only whether each action is locally valid, but whether the evolving trajectory still corresponds to the task the user authorized. Drift can accumulate quietly: an agent may call the right tool with plausible arguments at every step, while its prefix moves toward a broader role, an adjacent objective, or evidence the user never supplied. Existing monitors mostly check local compliance, deliver final-trace verdicts, or score generic risk; they do not directly estimate this prefix-level relation. We introduce ontological trust, a task-conditioned property of trajectory prefixes, and instantiate it as RGE, an online monitor that decomposes trust along Role, Goal, and Evidence. RGE uses LLMs only to derive structured task and step representations; trust-state updates, projec- tions, and intervention decisions are deterministic, so the output is a replayable and auditable trust trajectory rather than a single end-to-end judge verdict. We construct a cross-domain trajectory corpus from OSWorld, FinanceBench, and EICU-AC, covering benign executions, prefix-paired drift, and pseudo-consistency failures. On this corpus, RGE outperforms adapted rule-, judge-, and shield-style baselines on prefix-paired drift detection. With the two larger estimator models, it exceeds 93% Drift F1 on every benchmark while keeping benign coverage at or above 95.8%. Pseudo-consistency is harder: detection depends on whether task completion is externally visible, a structural limit we characterize empirically.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"本体论信任"(ontological trust)概念,形式化定义为长程智能体轨迹前缀相对于用户授权任务的任务条件属性,并实例化为RGE在线监控器,通过Role-Goal-Evidence三轴分解信任状态,在OSWorld、FinanceBench、EICU-AC三个领域实现前缀配对漂移检测Drift F1超93%,良性覆盖率≥95.8%。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体在多步骤执行中,即使每一步使用合法工具并产生合理参数,轨迹前缀仍可能逐渐偏离用户授权任务(扩展角色、替换目标、引入未授权证据)。现有监控器多检查局部合规性、最终轨迹判断或通用风险评分,缺乏对"前缀与授权任务对应关系"的直接估计,导致漂移问题难以被检测。
AI.method: 将受信任执行形式化为有界授权 D(x)=(R(x),G(x),E(x)),引入信任状态 T(x,h≤t)∈[0,1]³ 作为三轴(Role、Goal、Evidence)在线偏差估计。RGE监控器采用LLM仅用于结构化解析任务与步骤,状态更新、投影、聚合与干预决策均为确定性计算。流程包含:任务条件补全结构G(x)、局部语义解析p_t、映射至R/G/E一致性分数、含结构耦合项ϕ_t的瞬时偏差u_t、漏积分累加器s_t与短视指数移动平均c_t,最终通过阈值规则产生allow/justify/reanchor/contain干预标签。
AI.result: 在248条轨迹(80良性、81前缀配对漂移、87伪一致性)上,使用GPT-4o与Qwen3.5-9B作估计器时,每个基准上Drift F1均超过93%、良性覆盖率≥95.8%,显著优于改写的AgentSpec、R-Judge、AgentAuditor、MAS-Shield基线。消融实验表明:Role与Goal承载主要漂移信号,Evidence承载主要伪一致性信号,完整RGE组合在Drift F1、Pseudo F1、良性覆盖率三方面均优于任何子集。任务置换AUC达0.962–0.999,证明评分依赖于任务关系而非通用轨迹特征。伪一致性检测存在结构性上限,受任务闭合可观测性约束:OSWorld可达98.4% Pseudo F1,而读为主的FinanceBench/EICU-AC因缺乏外部闭合信号而难以区分合法验证与表面进度。
AI.conclusion: 本体论信任是长程委托任务监控的关键属性,RGE通过结构化三轴分解与确定性状态演化为审计与回放提供可追溯的信任轨迹,证明步级局部信号不足以恢复前缀-任务关系。未来工作需关注如何让智能体环境暴露更多闭合、授权与剩余行为的可监控接口,以突破伪一致性检测的结构性上限。

title: Evaluating the Diversity of AI-Generated Content with Diversity Profiles
summary: Diversity is a fundamental criterion for evaluating generative artificial intelligence (AI) systems, yet its measurement remains inherently ambiguous. Existing approaches typically represent generated samples in an embedding space, compute pairwise distances or similarities, and aggregate them into a single scalar score. Such scalar summaries are convenient, but they often encode different inductive biases and may yield contradictory rankings of the same sample sets. In this paper, we argue that diversity evaluation for AI-generated content is intrinsically under-specified when reduced to a single number. We first review representative diversity metrics, and then diagnose their limitations from two complementary perspectives: an axiomatic analysis showing that no representative scalar metric satisfies all desirable properties simultaneously, and an empirical analysis showing that high-dimensional representation spaces can induce concentrated, modality-dependent distance distributions. To address these issues, we propose diversity profiles: curve-valued, condition-aware summaries that evaluate a parameterized diversity family across a range of thresholds, scales, exponents, or orders under a specified representation and distance or kernel function. Diversity profiles reveal whether a comparison is robust across resolutions or instead depends on an arbitrary parameter choice. We instantiate profiles for several representative metric families and demonstrate their practical use in generative AI evaluation. Overall, diversity profiles provide a more transparent and resolution-aware framework for comparing the diversity of AI-generated content.

AI.tldr: 本文指出生成式AI内容的多样性评估在使用单一标量指标时存在根本性的欠定(under-specified)问题,并提出"多样性轮廓(Diversity Profiles)"作为一种曲线化、条件感知的评估框架,通过在参数化多样性族上扫描阈值/尺度/阶数等参数,揭示比较结果是否对参数选择鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI的多样性评估通常将样本嵌入到表示空间,计算两两距离后聚合成一个标量分数(如AvgDist、Energy、Circles、Vendi、Magnitude等)。但这些标量指标编码不同的归纳偏置,可能对同一组样本给出矛盾排序。本文从两个互补角度诊断其局限性:(1)公理化分析表明没有代表性标量指标能同时满足大小单调性(A1)、孪生性质(A2)、距离单调性(A3)、连续性(A4)四条公理;(2)实证分析表明高维表示空间中两两距离会出现与模态相关的集中现象,使任何单一阈值/尺度都内在脆弱。因此需要一种分辨率感知、透明的评估方式。
AI.method:
1. 系统综述代表性距离型多样性指标:Richness、AvgDist、Energy(s)、Circles(τ)、Vendi score(q)、Magnitude(t);
2. 通过4条公理(Size Monotonicity、Twin Property、Distance Monotonicity、Continuity)对各指标进行形式化分析,并给出反例证明(详见Table 1及Appendix A);
3. 通过ImageNet(ResNet-50余弦距离)、2WikiMultiHopQA(Qwen3-8B余弦距离)、ChEMBL(ECFP4 Tanimoto距离)三模态10万对距离的实证,展示距离集中现象;
4. 定义多样性轮廓 P = (ϕ, d, μ, Θ),即在表示ϕ、距离d、参数化族μ、参数域Θ下绘制曲线 P_X(θ)=μ_θ(D_X);
5. 实例化Energy、Circles、Vendi、Magnitude四种轮廓,分析其单调性/连续性等轮廓级性质,并给出曲线支配(稳健)与曲线交叉(分辨率相关折中)的解释规则;
6. 推荐在多指标族上联合报告轮廓以获得更全面的多样性判断。
AI.result:
1. Table 1 显示无任何代表性标量指标同时满足全部4条公理(如AvgDist满足A3A4但违反A1A2,Vendi满足A4但违反其余,等);
2. Figure 2 实证表明图像/文本/分子三模态下两两距离分布均高度集中且位置/形状随模态与距离函数变化;
3. Figure 1(一维示例 A={1,2,3} vs B={0,4})与 Figure 3(2WikiMultiHopQA真实样本,Qwen3-8B 4096维嵌入)展示不同指标族(Circles/Vendi/Magnitude/Energy)对同一对样本集给出不同甚至矛盾的排序,且轮廓曲线在参数扫描下存在交叉;
4. 轮廓计算成本低:在CPU上,50样本/超过100个参数点的轮廓计算耗时<1秒,适合常规生成式AI评估;
5. 建议参数域Θ依据经验距离分布选择(如Circles使用距离分位数),并跨多个指标族联合报告轮廓。
AI.conclusion: 多样性轮廓将生成式AI的多样性评估从"选择一个最佳标量"转变为"刻画跨分辨率与跨指标族的多样性比较行为",提供更透明、对超参选择不敏感、与多样性多面性本质一致的评估视角。论文同时承认局限:(i)仅关注多样性而非质量–多样性联合评估;(ii)轮廓是条件依赖的,实际部署仍需针对特定模态制定更详细的表示/参数域选取与支配–交叉解释指南。未来方向包括更深入的多样性指标–公理–轮廓性质关系理论,以及借鉴生态学α/β/γ多样性分解思想进行更系统的子集级分析。

title: Neuro-symbolic learning over OWL 2 DL via consequence-based compilation to differentiable circuits
comment: Accepted at NeSy 2026
summary: OWL 2 DL ontologies, grounded in the description logic $\mathcal{SROIQ}$, express large knowledge bases in biomedicine and the Semantic Web. Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) learners over description logics either embed the ontology in a continuous space, abandoning classical entailment, or restrict to the Horn fragment $\mathcal{EL}^{++}$, which has a single canonical model. We present Baobab, which compiles a $\mathcal{SROIQ}$ ontology with a finite ABox into a Sentential Decision Diagram (SDD): it saturates a propositional core under a consequence-based calculus and instantiates the remaining $\mathcal{SROIQ}$ features (nominals, number restrictions, and the role axioms) over the active domain.
